items.titleEn: Arrighetti leaves 1st rehab start in Blue Jays' system with apparent injury
bodyEn: Spencer Arrighetti, who the Blue Jays acquired at the Trade Deadline for outfielder Daulton Varsho, made his first rehab appearance in Toronto’s system on Thursday, but he left early with an apparent injury.

The 26-year-old Arrighetti, who has been on the injured list since July 25 with right foot nerve irritation, was removed after 2 1/3 hitless innings with Triple-A Buffalo. He threw 39 pitches before he was lifted from the game.

In 17 starts for the Astros this season, Arrighetti had a 4.60 ERA and 87 strikeouts in 88 innings. The right-hander owns a career 4.66 ERA with 289 strikeouts in 268 1/3 innings. His best season came as a rookie in 2024, when Arrighetti had a 4.53 ERA with 171 strikeouts in 145 innings.
Before his latest potential setback, it seemed like we would see Arrighetti on an MLB mound at some point in August. Now, that timetable is a little more uncertain.

items.summaryZh: Arrighetti在蓝鸟3A复健首秀疑似受伤提前退场，回归时间表存疑。
bodyZh: 蓝鸟在交易截止日用外野手Daulton Varsho换来的Spencer Arrighetti，周四在蓝鸟体系首次复健出赛，但疑似受伤提前离场。
26岁的Arrighetti自7月25日起因右脚神经刺激进入伤病名单，他在3A水牛城先发，投了2又1/3局无安打后被换下场，共投39球。
本赛季为太空人先发17场，Arrighetti自责分率4.60，在88局中投出87次三振。这位右投手生涯自责分率4.66，在268又1/3局中投出289次三振。他表现最好的赛季是2024年新秀赛季，当时自责分率4.53，在145局中投出171次三振。
在最近这次可能的挫折之前，我们原本有望在8月的某个时候看到Arrighetti登上大联盟投手丘。现在，这个时间表更加不确定了。

items.titleEn: 18 days after taking liner off head, Jays' top pitching prospect dominates at Double-A
bodyEn: Nolan Perry went 18 days between starts for Double-A New Hampshire. The last time he stood on a Minor League mound was July 19, when a line drive hit him flush on the side of the head. Toronto originally stated he would be week-to-week in his concussion recovery, but after just two and a half weeks away and having cleared all protocols, he was right back on the bump.

Making his home debut at Delta Dental Stadium on Thursday night, Perry showed no signs of being worse for wear. He pumped his first two pitches right down the middle for strikes and struck out the first two batters swinging on wicked breaking balls. By the time he was done, the Blue Jays’ No. 2 prospect had tossed three no-hit frames and racked up four punchouts in New Hampshire’s 5-2 win over Portland.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »

At the start of 2026, Perry was a relative unknown outside of the Florida State League circuit and the Blue Jays’ complex in Dunedin. Not ranked on the club’s preseason Top 30 Prospects list, he has enjoyed a meteoric rise over the past few months, now Toronto's top-ranked pitching prospect and No. 92 overall in baseball.

All four of Perry’s punchouts Thursday came on breaking balls, benders so nasty that even catcher Aaron Parker was unable to corral the first one as it went to the backstop before he completed the out. The 22-year-old threw first-pitch strikes to nine of the 10 batters he faced and didn’t allow a ball to leave the infield, yielding a baserunner only on a hit by pitch.

By virtue of his relatively speedy recovery, the Fisher Cats were able to pencil Perry into the rotation and utilize right-hander Gage Stanifer (TOR No. 7) as a piggyback. As nasty of a one-two punch as you’ll find in the Eastern League, Stanifer struck out five (while walking five) across four one-hit, one-run frames.

Perry has been a major development success story for the Blue Jays, who nabbed him with their 12th-round selection in the 2022 Draft out of the New Mexico high school prep ranks. He was an over-slot signing but not a major one, landing a $200,000 signing bonus. After getting clobbered in his first taste of pro ball in ‘23 (7.28 ERA across nine outings in the Florida Complex League), he broke out with an impressive Single-A debut in ‘24 before his elbow gave out after 14 starts.

What a pitcher looks like post-Tommy John surgery is always up in the air, but after missing all of 2025, Perry dominated the lower levels earlier this season. He allowed one earned run or fewer in all five of his Dunedin starts before getting the bump to High-A Vancouver in May. He won Northwest League Pitcher of the Month honors in June, and by the end of that month was ready for the challenge of the upper Minors.

While Toronto has largely kept Perry’s pitch count in check as he works his way back from the torn UCL, he’s been electric when on the mound. Across 59 innings, he's allowed just 38 hits and struck out 89 batters. He ranks fourth in the system in punchouts despite that capped workload and would lead in average-against, WHIP and several other categories if he had the requisite number of innings to qualify.

There’s plenty of good news elsewhere on mounds across the farm as well: Ricky Tiedemann (TOR No. 10) -- once the club’s top pitching prospect in his own right -- returned to Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday night and tossed a scoreless inning of relief. He averaged 96.7 mph with his fastball and has given up just one run on three hits across five innings as he returns to action after dealing with left elbow soreness earlier this year.

Toronto also welcomed aboard a pair of new faces to its deepening pitching crop earlier this week. Dasan Hill (TOR No. 6) and John Klein (No. 25) both slotted in among the organization’s Top 30 prospects after arriving in the Jeff Hoffman trade with Minnesota. Hill's first start in his new system is set for Sunday with Vancouver, where he will join fellow fast-rising southpaw Johnny King (No. 3) in the rotation.
items.titleZh: 头部被平飞球击中18天后，蓝鸟顶级投手新秀在双A联赛中展现统治力
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟投手新秀Perry在头部被平飞球击中18天后复出，3局无安打并送出4次三振。
bodyZh: Nolan Perry在双A新罕布什尔队的两次先发之间相隔了18天。他上一次站上小联盟投手丘是在7月19日，当时一颗平飞球正中他的头部侧面。多伦多最初表示他的脑震荡恢复情况将按周观察，但仅仅缺席了两个半星期并通过了所有协议后，他就重新站上了投手丘。
周四晚在Delta Dental Stadium的主场首秀中，Perry丝毫没有表现出不适。他的前两球直接投进好球带正中央，并依靠犀利的变化球让前两名打者挥空三振。退场时，这位蓝鸟2号新秀已经投出三局无安打，并送出四次三振，帮助新罕布什尔队以5-2击败波特兰。
获取您附近小联盟比赛的门票 »
在2026年年初，Perry在佛罗里达州联赛和达尼丁蓝鸟基地之外还算相对无名。他未进入球队季前30大新秀名单，但在过去几个月里迅速崛起，如今已是多伦多排名第一的投手新秀，在棒球总排名中位列第92位。
周四，Perry的全部四次三振都来自变化球，这些变化球犀利无比，第一个球甚至让捕手Aaron Parker未能接住，球滚到挡网后才完成出局。这位22岁小将面对10名打者，有9人首球好球，且没有让球飞出内场，仅因触身球让对手上垒一次。
凭借相对快速的恢复，Fisher Cats得以将Perry列入先发轮值，并使用右投手Gage Stanifer（蓝鸟第7号新秀）作为接力，这对组合是东区联盟最犀利的组合拳。Stanifer在四局中送出五次三振（也有五次保送），仅被敲一安打失一分。
Perry是蓝鸟发展体系中的一个重要成功案例。蓝鸟在2022年选秀第12轮选中了他，他当时来自新墨西哥州的高中球员行列。他是一笔溢价签约，但并非大手笔，只拿到了20万美元签约金。在2023年首次体验职业棒球时他遭到重创（在佛罗里达综合联盟的9场出赛中自责分率高达7.28），随后在2024年的1A首秀中表现出色，但他在14次先发后肘部受伤。
投手在Tommy John手术后的状态总是充满变数，但在缺席整个2025赛季后，Perry在本赛季早些时候统治了低级别联赛。他在达尼丁的5场先发中每场失分不超过1分，之后于5月升至高阶1A的温哥华。他赢得了6月份西北联盟月度最佳投手奖，并在6月底做好了迎接更高级别小联盟挑战的准备。
多伦多严格限制着Perry的用球数，因为他在从尺侧副韧带撕裂中恢复，但只要登上投手丘，他依然生猛。在59局中，他只被敲出38支安打，并三振了89名打者。尽管工作量受限，他的三振数在球队体系中排名第四，而如果他的局数达到参评标准，他将在被打击率、WHIP等多项数据中领先。
农场体系中其他投手也有不少好消息。Ricky Tiedemann（蓝鸟第10号新秀）——曾凭自身实力成为球队头号投手新秀——周三晚回到3A水牛城，后援一局无失分。他的速球平均时速96.7英里。在复出后的5局中，仅被敲3支安打失1分。他今年早些时候因左肘酸痛缺阵，如今已重返赛场。
本周早些时候，多伦多也迎来了两位新面孔，为日益深厚的投手阵容增添力量。Dasan Hill（蓝鸟第6号新秀）和John Klein（第25号新秀）在涉及Jeff Hoffman与明尼苏达的交易中加盟后，双双进入球队30大新秀名单。Hill在新体系中的首场先发定于周日随温哥华出战，届时他将与另一位迅速崛起的左投Johnny King（第3号新秀）一同进入先发轮值。

items.titleEn: Cease's 7-inning gem goes for naught in Blue Jays' deflating 11-inning loss
bodyEn: CHICAGO -- Thursday looked like one of those days where the Blue Jays could use as a reason to cling to hope for a deep postseason run, heck, or even a return of October baseball.

Dylan Cease was magnificent for seven innings, the defense was strong and the bullpen was just as solid for five outs. But the Blue Jays needed six outs from their relievers, and their woes with runners in scoring position stopped them from picking up a win in a makeup contest against the Cubs.

Alex Bregman hit a two-strike, two-out two-run home run in the ninth to force extras and Pete Crow-Armstrong scored on a throwing error from catcher Brandon Valenzuela as he stole third to walk it off and hand the Blue Jays a 3-2 loss in 11 innings at Wrigley Field.

But it likely won’t be Bregman’s blast or Crow-Armstrong’s swipe that the Blue Jays will be kicking themselves about -- it’s the 1-for-19 with runners in scoring position and the 13 runners left on base in the loss. The Blue Jays outhit the Cubs 11-5, but failed to advance the extra-innings runner past second base in both frames.

“Just didn’t get the hits we needed to,” manager John Schneider said. “There’s a lot left on. It gets magnified, obviously, in extras when you get a guy there. But just couldn’t sequence them out the way we wanted to today against [Cubs starter David] Peterson or really the rest of the way, except for [Alejandro Kirk’s RBI single in the seventh]. Had chances to add on. Leadoff double in the ninth, had a chance to add on.”

It’s been a bugaboo for the Blue Jays this season. They have the second-fewest plate appearances in baseball with runners in scoring position (991), and their .695 OPS in those situations is fifth-worst. They had runners in scoring position in eight of their 11 innings on Thursday.
And it spoiled a terrific outing from their ace, Cease. The right-hander tossed seven scoreless innings, striking out 10 and permitting just two hits and a walk.

“You want to get the offense going,” Schneider said. “You want to either get some timely hits or add some slug like we’ve talked about a lot. The other phases of the game, I like what they’re doing. I like the way they’re competing, and you got to brush this off, leave it here and go on to Philly.”

It was the continuation of a dominant stretch for Cease. The right-hander owns a 0.84 ERA (4 ER/43 IP) and 0.67 WHIP over his last six starts. He continued that hot stretch Thursday by using his full repertoire. Cease used almost all his six pitches his first time through the order, keeping the Cubs’ lineup guessing. He leaned more heavily on his fastball-slider mix as the game wore on, and that allowed him to be dominant throughout the outing.

That diversity of his pitch mix allowed the fastball-slider combo, particularly the heater, to improve as the day wore on. Cease’s average fastball velocity jumped from 94.9 mph in the first inning to a peak of 97.3 mph in the sixth. Two of his hardest thrown pitches came in the seventh.

“I feel like I’m mixing in more variety of pitches and I feel like I’m getting them to better spots, too,” Cease said. “It feels like some days in the past would really just be very slider-fastball heavy, and if I didn’t have one or the other, it would be a massive grind. Where now I can mix in a first-pitch curveball -- and go to the sweeper and go to the sinker -- and things like that that I haven’t historically done very well in the past, and that’s helping me just diversify my pitches and be less predictable.”

The Blue Jays had jumped ahead in the first inning when Kazuma Okamoto scored from third base after Peterson had disengaged three times off the mound. The left-hander threw over to first base three times to try and pick off George Springer. When the final throw over was unsuccessful, each runner was awarded a base, and that would be the Blue Jays’ lone run until Alejandro Kirk’s RBI single in the seventh.
After the loss at Wrigley, the Blue Jays sit 3 1/2 games back of the third and final Wild Card spot with 46 games remaining.
items.titleZh: Cease七局好投成空 蓝鸟11局惜败小熊
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟虽先驰得点，但得点圈打击乏力，11局遭小熊逆转，3比2落败。
bodyZh: 芝加哥——周四原本看起来是蓝鸟可以借此对深入季后赛甚至重返十月棒球保持希望的日子之一。
Dylan Cease在七局中表现出色，防守稳固，牛棚在前五个出局数中也同样扎实。但蓝鸟需要后援投手投六个出局数，而他们在得点圈有跑者时的糟糕表现令他们未能在对阵小熊的补赛中取胜。
Alex Bregman在第九局两人出局、两好球时轰出两分本垒打，将比赛拖入延长局；Pete Crow-Armstrong在盗三垒时因捕手Brandon Valenzuela的传球失误得分，完成再见跑垒，在瑞格利球场以3比2让蓝鸟在11局中落败。
但蓝鸟或许不会为Bregman的本垒打或Crow-Armstrong的盗垒而懊恼——而是得点圈有人时19打数1安打，以及留下13个跑者在垒上。蓝鸟的安打数以11比5领先小熊，但在两个延长局中均未能将自动上垒的跑者推进到二垒以后。
“我们就是没能打出需要的安打，”主教练John Schneider说。“留下了太多跑者。显然在延长局，当你有跑者在二垒时，这被放大了。但今天面对（小熊先发投手David）Peterson或者其余投手时，我们就是无法按想要的方式串联安打，除了（Alejandro Kirk在第七局的打点一垒安打）。有追加得分的机会。第九局首名打者击出二垒安打，也有追加得分的机会。”
这已经是蓝鸟本赛季的老大难问题。他们在得点圈有跑者时的打席数为991，全联盟第二少；而在这些情况下的OPS为.695，排名第五差。周四的11局中他们有8局有跑者处于得点圈。
而这也糟蹋了王牌投手Cease的一次精彩先发。这位右投手投了七局无失分，送出10次三振，只被击出两支安打和一次保送。
“你希望让进攻运转起来，”Schneider说。“你希望打出及时安打，或者像我们经常谈到的增加长打。比赛的其他环节，我喜欢他们的表现。我喜欢他们的竞争方式，你得把这场失利抛在脑后，把它留在这里，然后前往费城。”
这是Cease统治级表现期的延续。这位右投手在过去六次先发中自责分率为0.84（4自责分/43局），WHIP为0.67。周四他通过使用全部球种延续了火热状态。Cease在第一轮面对打线时几乎用了他六种球路中的全部，让小熊打线捉摸不透。随着比赛深入，他更加依赖速球和滑球的组合，这使他在整场先发中保持统治力。
球种搭配的多样性让速球-滑球组合，尤其是速球，随着比赛进行而愈发犀利。Cease的平均速球球速从第一局的94.9英里/小时提升到第六局的峰值97.3英里/小时。他投出的两颗最快速球出现在第七局。
“我觉得我在搭配更多种类的球路，而且也能把球投到更好的位置，”Cease说。“过去有些日子真的会非常依赖滑球和速球，如果其中一种感觉不好，那就会非常挣扎。而现在我可以混入首球曲球——然后使用扫球、伸卡球——这些是我过去历史上并不擅长的，这帮助我多样化我的球种，变得不那么可预测。”
蓝鸟在首局率先得分。当时Kazuma Okamoto从三垒跑回本垒，因为Peterson三次从投手板退开。这位左投手三次向一垒传球试图牵制George Springer。当最后一次牵制传球不成功时，每位跑者被判定推进一个垒包，这成为蓝鸟直到第七局Alejandro Kirk打点一垒安打之前的唯一得分。
在瑞格利球场失利后，蓝鸟在还有46场比赛的情况下，落后第三个且最后一个外卡席位3.5个胜场。

items.titleEn: 'Could we please not?': Gausman says goodbye to Blue Jays without facing them
bodyEn: CHICAGO -- In many ways, the Blue Jays playing a makeup game against the Cubs at Wrigley Field is a blessing. But there’s a part of Kevin Gausman that also hoped it was a full series.

“I wish it was for more than just one day, so I could maybe go to dinner with a couple of the guys and really say bye,” Gausman said on Thursday morning in the Cubs’ clubhouse at Wrigley Field, donning Cubs gear. “But it is what it is, at least I get to see them again.”

Gausman was dealt to the Cubs on Sunday for a pair of prospects, as the team was on a flight to Houston for a three-game set. Manager John Schneider called Gausman to the front of the plane and let him know he had been dealt to Chicago. The right-hander went back to his spot on the plane, near George Springer and Daulton Varsho (who would later be traded, too), and gave them the news.

“I just kind of went back there and stood there kind of awkwardly for a second,” Gausman said. “I think they could kind of tell something was going on. I love both those guys and thoroughly enjoyed my time with them. So saying bye to them was hard, for sure.”
The news was equally as difficult to deliver for Schneider, who had developed a close bond with Gausman during their time together in Toronto.

“I got a little emotional just because of the time he spent here, what he meant to this organization, how he felt for this organization and the city and the country and how he was just so revered, really, by a lot of the fan base,” Schneider said.

“It was weird. The timing of those things, you never really know, and we were a little bit late taking off and thought we would have landed already when the news broke, but it’s that time of year. The Trade Deadline is always weird.”

The 35-year-old followed the rest of the moves the Blue Jays made at the Deadline, noting that he “thought they did really good for the future.” While Varsho might have briefly thought he was staying in Toronto after the Blue Jays acquired José Soriano, Gausman didn’t try to stomach the “What if?” scenario of being teammates with Soriano and the Blue Jays.

“Yeah, I’m not going to say anything like that,” Gausman said. “I’m happy for them over there. I do think they got better. They definitely got younger, getting rid of me. That helps. But listen, I wish nothing but the best for that organization and especially those guys. I texted Varsh, ‘Go ‘Stros.’
“It’s weird, but it’s part of the business. It’s kind of what we sign up for.”

Gausman’s final start with the Blue Jays came on Aug. 1 against the Cardinals, meaning he was in line to start Thursday’s makeup game. But the idea of facing his former team with the emotions still raw was tough for him to stomach.

“I didn’t necessarily ask [not to pitch], but I was like, could we please not, you know,” Gausman said. “I just know it would be a lot. I just want to focus on trying to win a game and pitching against them. I think I could do it, I know those hitters pretty well over there. I know their strengths, their weaknesses.
“But I think it would be a lot mentally and for them, too.”

Instead, Gausman used Thursday as an opportunity to catch up with his teammates and issue a proper farewell, rather than a rushed one aboard a chartered plane -- or toeing the rubber to pitch against them.

“Listen, really close with all those guys and wish them nothing but the best,” Gausman said. “Looking forward to watching us play them today and seeing those guys again. But definitely glad I’m not facing them.”
items.titleZh: '我们能不这样吗？' Gausman告别蓝鸟未与老东家交手
items.summaryZh: 被交易到小熊的Gausman在补赛日与蓝鸟老队友告别，坦言不愿面对老东家。
bodyZh: 芝加哥——从很多方面来说，蓝鸟在瑞格利球场与小熊进行补赛是一件好事。但Kevin Gausman内心有一部分也希望能打满整个系列赛。
“我希望这次不止一天，这样我或许能和几个家伙共进晚餐，真正地告别，”Gausman周四早上在瑞格利球场的小熊队休息室里穿着小熊装备说。“但事实就是如此，至少我还能再见到他们。”
Gausman在周日被交易到小熊，换来两名潜力新秀，当时球队正在飞往休斯敦参加三场系列赛的航班上。主教练John Schneider把Gausman叫到飞机前部，告诉他已经交易到芝加哥。这位右投手回到自己在飞机上的座位，座位在George Springer和Daulton Varsho（后来也被交易）旁边，并把消息告诉了他们。
“我就那样走回去，有点尴尬地站了一会儿，”Gausman说。“我觉得他们大概能感觉到出了什么事。我很爱那两个家伙，非常享受和他们相处的时光。所以和他们告别当然很难。”
对于Schneider来说，传达这个消息同样困难，他在多伦多与Gausman共事期间建立了紧密的关系。
“我有点情绪化，因为他在队里待的时间、他对这支球队的意义、他对球队和这座城市以及这个国家的感情，还有他确实受到很多球迷的尊崇，”Schneider说。
“这很奇怪。这类事情的时机你永远无法预料，我们起飞晚了一点，本以为消息传出时我们已经降落了，但这就是每年的这个时候。交易截止日总是很奇怪。”
这位35岁的球员关注了蓝鸟在交易截止日的其他操作，指出他“认为他们为未来做得非常好。”尽管在蓝鸟得到José Soriano后，Varsho可能一度以为自己会留在多伦多，但Gausman没有去纠结与Soriano和蓝鸟成为队友的“如果”情景。
“是的，我不会说那样的话，”Gausman说。“我为他们高兴。我确实认为他们变好了。他们肯定变得更年轻了，把我送走了。那有帮助。但听着，我对那支球队祝愿一切顺利，尤其是那些家伙。我给Varsh发了短信，‘加油，太空人。’”
“这很奇怪，但这是生意的一部分。这就是我们选择的工作。”
Gausman为蓝鸟的最后一次先发是在8月1日对阵红雀，这意味着他本来应该在周四的补赛中先发。但在情绪尚未平复时面对老东家的想法让他难以接受。
“我并不一定要请求（不投球），但我心想，我们能不这样吗，你懂的，”Gausman说。“我知道那会很难。我只想专注于赢得一场比赛并面对他们投球。我觉得我能做到，我很了解那边的打者。我知道他们的优势和弱点。
“但我认为这在心理上会很难，对他们来说也是。”
相反，Gausman利用周四作为与队友叙旧、正式告别的机会，而不是在包机上匆匆告别，或者踏上投手丘面对他们投球。
“听着，我和那些家伙关系真的很好，祝愿他们一切顺利，”Gausman说。“期待今天看我们对他们比赛，再次见到那些家伙。但绝对庆幸我没有面对他们。”

items.titleEn: Vladdy out of lineup again while dealing with hamstring tightness
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is out of the Blue Jays’ lineup for the finale in Houston after he looked uncomfortable after running out a ground ball late in Tuesday’s game.

Guerrero is still available off the bench and the Blue Jays are not considering an IL stint right now, but manager John Schneider recognized that Guerrero needed a day off -- at least one -- during a long stretch without a scheduled off day.

“He’s grinding. I think everyone is,” Schneider said. “He’s had some hamstring tightness. It’s a little bit of that to give him a blow, then a little bit of the quick turnaround, just to give him a reset. He’s feeling OK, but he’s been dealing with that and some other things for a while.”

Guerrero has been dealing with that hamstring issue for a while now. That’s on top of a nagging back problem that’s dragged through the season. More than previous seasons -- or at least more publicly -- it seems like Guerrero is wearing the grind of this season, physically.

He’s also insistent that the Blue Jays can still make a run, though, and spoke Tuesday about how he needs to do more to help that happen, so Guerrero isn’t looking for off days and certainly isn’t looking for an IL stint.
“He wants to be out there. He wants to be contributing more than he is,” Schneider said. “I’ll talk to him today as the day goes, then when we get into Chicago.”
Guerrero’s numbers have been the story of the season for the 53-61 Blue Jays, batting .259 with a .687 OPS. He’s homered just six times, zero of them coming at Rogers Centre in Toronto.

There’s a valid argument to be made that, if 10 days on the shelf would help Guerrero come back refreshed and re-energized, it could help the club in the long-term without sacrificing much in the short term.

“It’s a delicate one. We’re talking about one of the most important guys on our team,” Schneider said. “I always feel good with him in the lineup, his presence, what he can do and what he has done for a long time. I’ll just continue to talk to him and see what he thinks is best for him. He’s got a pretty good feel of what is best for him and what is best for the team. This is a big boy league. If you’re feeling good enough to go and you can help us, I want you to do that.”
The Blue Jays should have a clearer picture by the time they play Thursday in Chicago, a quick one-game stop to make up for a game rained out earlier this season.
items.titleZh: 弗拉迪因腿筋紧张再次缺阵
items.summaryZh: 弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗二世因腿筋紧张连续缺阵，球队暂不考虑伤病名单。
bodyZh: 休斯顿——周二晚比赛中，弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗二世在跑完一个滚地球后显得不适，因此他将缺席蓝鸟在休斯顿的系列赛收官战。
格雷罗仍可作为替补出场，蓝鸟目前不考虑将他放入伤病名单，但主教练约翰·施奈德认为，在连续没有休息日的赛程中，格雷罗至少需要休息一天。
施奈德说：“他一直在坚持。我觉得每个人都在坚持。他的腿筋有些紧张。一部分原因是让他喘口气，再加上赛程紧凑，让他重新调整一下。他感觉还行，但他已经带着这个问题和其他一些不适坚持了一段时间。”
格雷罗的腿筋问题已经持续了一段时间，此外还有整个赛季都在困扰他的背部老伤。相比前几个赛季，至少从公开表现来看，格雷罗本赛季在身体上承受了更多消耗。
不过，他坚称蓝鸟仍有冲击季后赛的机会，并在周二表示他需要做得更多来帮助球队实现这一目标，因此他并不希望休息，更不想进伤病名单。
施奈德说：“他想上场。他希望能贡献更多。我今天会和他聊聊，等我们到了芝加哥再谈。”
对于53胜61负的蓝鸟来说，格雷罗的数据一直是本赛季的焦点：打击率.259，OPS为.687。他只打出6支本垒打，其中没有一支是在多伦多罗杰斯中心打出的。
有一种合理的观点认为，如果休息10天能让格雷罗恢复活力，从长远来看可能对球队有利，而短期内也不会损失太多。
施奈德说：“这是个需要谨慎处理的问题。我们谈论的是球队最重要的球员之一。他出现在阵容中时，我总感觉很好，他的存在感、他的能力以及他长期以来做到的事情。我会继续和他沟通，看看他认为怎样对自己最好。他对自己和球队的最佳选择有很好的判断。这是成年人的联盟。如果你觉得身体状态足够好，能帮助我们，我希望你上场。”
蓝鸟将在周四芝加哥的比赛中获得更清晰的情况，那是为了补赛本赛季早前一场因雨取消的比赛而进行的一场快速客场之旅。

items.titleEn: Get to know Toronto's trio of new starters
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
HOUSTON -- The Blue Jays’ rotation has taken a dozen different shapes this season. Remember February, when we began the spring talking about this club having too many starters?

Kevin Gausman is gone now, traded to the Cubs at the Deadline, and in are the duo of José Soriano and Jameson Taillon. They’ll be joined soon by Spencer Arrighetti, who is nearing the end of his rehab from a foot injury after being acquired from the Astros.
This is what you need to know about Toronto’s new starters:
RHP José SorianoTrade: From Angels for INF Arjun Nimmala, OF Eddie Micheletti Jr., RHP Angel RiveroRole: Potential No. 2 starter

The Blue Jays’ big swing of the deadline represents long-term upside with team control through the 2027 and ‘28 seasons. The Blue Jays’ front office has a high hit rate on these bigger, bolder moves, and there’s a lot to love about Soriano’s profile.

Look at this as another Dylan Cease project. No, he’s not as talented as Cease because few pitchers on this planet are, but the challenge is the same. Soriano is wildly talented, but just needs to rein his powers and control the zone. If he can cut down his walks just a bit and dominate in the zone more, there’s another level to be unlocked.

“There’s nothing glaring, but I think the one thing is just harnessing his stuff in the zone,” said manager John Schneider. “It’s trying to limit the walks and trying not to be on the edges as much. When you’re acquiring a guy like that, you look at everything, including the catcher’s setup and the catcher’s framing, pitch usage, all of that stuff. There’s certain guys you look at and see that there’s definitely an arsenal tweak, but I don’t think there’s one with him.
Keep that catching comment in mind. Coming from the Angels to the Blue Jays, as a pitcher, is a massive upgrade in terms of the value Soriano will receive from his catchers.
RHP Spencer ArrighettiTrade: From Astros for OF Daulton VarshoRole: Potential No. 5 starter
Arrighetti is a Houston boy, and was living out his dream of playing for the hometown team. These past few days haven’t been easy.

“It was every emotion there is, all at once,” Arrighetti said. “Obviously, I had this bubble of supreme comfort being in Houston and being from Houston. My family had the luxury of being at just about every game I ever pitched here. That’s probably the hardest part to part with. My house is 20 minutes from here. That’s where I’m going to raise my kids. Houston will always be home.”

He’s excited to begin a new chapter, though, and once he’s done his rehab in Triple-A, he’ll slide right into the rotation. If all goes well and the Blue Jays can work with Arrighetti to get him more consistent, he could solidify the back end of this group in 2027 and beyond.

“I’ve played at Rogers Centre a couple of times now, so I’m incredibly excited to get there and to represent an entire country,” Arrighetti said. “That’s something I’m very proud of and very excited for.”
RHP Jameson TaillonTrade: From Cubs with cash for a player to be named later or cashRole: No. 5 starter entering free agency

When Taillon spoke to the media for the first time in Houston, he said he was just happy to have a uniform. He’s been in the big leagues for a decade and is a former No. 2 overall pick in the 2010 Draft, but there’s no ego here, which Schneider loves.

“His reputation around the league is pristine,” Schneider said. “People who have played with him, who have managed him, coached him, they all say the same thing. We’ve seen it in the first 48 hours here. He’s a dude. He’s all about winning, all about the team and doesn’t put himself first. That’s a huge plus to not only the staff but the clubhouse too.”

When Taillon was a free agent in 2022, prior to signing his four-year, $68 million deal with the Cubs, the Blue Jays reached out multiple times with interest. Eventually, they signed Chris Bassitt. Now a pending free agent, Taillon has plenty of motivation and is fully confident he still has something left in the tank. If he proves that, perhaps the Blue Jays’ interest is rekindled and they can discuss ‘27.
items.titleZh: 了解蓝鸟三位新先发投手
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟队交易截止日引进Soriano、Arrighetti和Taillon三位新先发投手。
bodyZh: 本故事摘自Keegan Matheson的《蓝鸟节拍》新闻简报。要阅读完整简报，请点击此处。并订阅以便定期在收件箱中获取。
休斯敦——蓝鸟队的先发轮值本赛季已经出现了十几种不同的形态。还记得二月份吗？当时我们开始春训时还在说这支球队先发投手太多了。
Kevin Gausman现在已经离队，在交易截止日被交易到了小熊队，取而代之的是José Soriano和Jameson Taillon这对组合。很快，Spencer Arrighetti也将加入他们，他在从太空人队被交易来之后，脚伤康复已接近尾声。
以下是你需要了解的多伦多新先发投手：
右投手José Soriano 交易：从天使队换来内野手Arjun Nimmala、外野手Eddie Micheletti Jr.、右投手Angel Rivero 角色：潜在的2号先发
蓝鸟队在截止日的这次大动作代表着长期潜力，球队控制权持续到2027和28赛季。蓝鸟队管理层在这些更大胆的操作上成功率很高，Soriano的技术特点有很多值得喜欢的地方。
可以把这个看作另一个Dylan Cease项目。不，他没有Cease那么有天赋，因为这个星球上很少有投手能做到，但挑战是一样的。Soriano天赋异禀，但需要控制自己的力量并掌控好球区。如果他能稍微减少保送，更多地在好球区内统治对手，还能解锁更高的水平。
“没有什么明显的问题，但我认为唯一的一件事就是在好球区充分利用他的球路，”主教练John Schneider说。“要设法限制保送，尽量少投边缘球。当你交易来这样的球员时，你会审视一切，包括捕手的站位和接捕框架、配球等等。有些球员你会觉得他的球种肯定需要调整，但我不认为他是其中之一。”
记住关于捕手的那段话。从天使队来到蓝鸟队，作为一名投手，在Soriano从捕手那里获得的帮助方面，这是一个巨大的升级。
右投手Spencer Arrighetti 交易：从太空人队换来外野手Daulton Varsho 角色：潜在的5号先发
Arrighetti是休斯敦本地人，一直实现着为家乡球队效力的梦想。过去这几天并不轻松。
“百感交集，一下子涌上来，”Arrighetti说。“显然，在休斯敦打球、身为休斯敦人，我有一种极其舒适的环境。我的家人几乎能到场看我在这里的每一场先发。这大概是最难割舍的部分。我家离这里只有20分钟车程。那是我要养育孩子的地方。休斯敦永远是我的家。”
不过，他很期待开启新篇章，一旦他在3A完成康复，就会直接进入先发轮值。如果一切顺利，蓝鸟队能够帮助Arrighetti变得更加稳定，他有望在2027年及以后夯实这个轮值的后段。
“我已经在Rogers Centre打过几次球了，所以能去那里代表整个国家，我非常兴奋，”Arrighetti说。“这是我非常自豪和期待的事情。”
右投手Jameson Taillon 交易：从小熊队得到Jameson Taillon和现金，送出日后指定球员或现金 角色：即将成为自由球员的5号先发
当Taillon在休斯敦第一次接受媒体采访时，他说他只要有球衣穿就很开心了。他已经在大联盟打了十年，是2010年选秀的榜眼秀，但他毫无架子，这正是Schneider喜爱的地方。
“他在联盟中的声誉无可挑剔，”Schneider说。“和他做过队友、当过他的经理和教练的人，说的都一样。我们在这里的头48小时就见识到了。他是个真正的汉子。他一心想着赢球，想着球队，从不把自己放在第一位。这对教练组和更衣室都是巨大的加分。”
2022年Taillon成为自由球员时，在和小熊队签下四年6800万美元合同之前，蓝鸟队曾多次表达兴趣。最终，他们签下了Chris Bassitt。如今Taillon即将成为自由球员，他动力十足，并且完全相信自己油箱里还有油。如果他证明了这一点，也许蓝鸟队的兴趣会重新燃起，他们可以讨论2027年的合约。

items.titleEn: Clement breaks the seal in 10th to keep post-Deadline momentum going
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- The odds are stacked heavily against them, but the Blue Jays aren’t lying down following the Trade Deadline.

Wednesday’s 5-4 win over the Astros in extra innings gave them a series win over the AL West leaders, powered by Ernie Clement’s 10th-inning blast. The Blue Jays still have a mountain to climb, but if they’re going to do it, it has to start somewhere.
This is what mattered most:
1. Ernie Clement comes up big in extras

What a swing from Clement, who turned on the first pitch he saw in the top of the 10th and launched a no-doubter over the wall in left. These are exactly the types of swings the Blue Jays need more of, game-breakers that can wipe away their problems in an instant.

Hunter Brown carried a no-hitter into the sixth inning before Myles Straw broke it up with a double, continuing his best stretch of the season. Jesús Sánchez followed that up with a big, two-run shot to right, and the Blue Jays will be looking for more of that from him in August and September.

“It’s been consistently inconsistent for a lot of this year,” manager John Schneider said. “Not just individuals, but as a group, too. Knowing who we have here, we’re trying to figure out a way where we can generate some offense. We’re not saying, ‘Hey, Myles Straw, come hit 10 home runs in the month of August.’ It’s about using everyone’s skills to figure out the best way to do that.”

So many of the Blue Jays’ problems can be solved by power. The quickest path to that is a resurgence from Vladimir Guerrero Jr., who was left out of Wednesday’s starting lineup as he deals with some hamstring tightness, but the Blue Jays’ power outage has crept through their entire lineup. If this team is going to pull off a miracle run down the stretch, it needs to take big swings and big risks. Wednesday was a great example of how one big swing can make you forget about the other hundred swings in a game.
2. Still work ahead for Jameson Taillon

There was plenty of hard contact early on for Jameson Taillon, who loaded the bases and escaped the first inning without a run scoring, but eventually, Jose Altuve launched one. That’s when the game broke open for the Astros on Taillon.

“Strike throwing is a big thing, locating is a big thing. It’s similar to [Shane] Bieber, with a few more pitches,” Schneider said. “When you’re putting the ball where you want to and mixing your pitches well, you’ll have a pretty good shot. Hitting is hard. Chris [Bassitt] was a little bit different and he may have 12 pitches now by this point in his career. But with Jameson, understand what your strengths are. If you need to lean into a pitch or two as your outing goes, go ahead.”

Taillon lasted four innings of three-run ball, and while it wasn’t sharp, the recent injury to Trey Yesavage puts Taillon in line to stick in the rotation. Spencer Arrighetti is rehabbing Thursday with Triple-A Buffalo, but even if he returns to the big leagues soon, the Blue Jays had been eager to shift to a six-man rotation prior to Yesavage going down and that would offer another opportunity to stick to that plan, at least in the short term.
3. Stock Up: Spencer Miles

Miles had runners on second and third with no outs in the bottom of the sixth. Two harmless popups and a strikeout later, he’d escaped. In a season of great moments for Miles, he just keeps proving there’s more in there.

Miles now owns a 3.04 ERA with 71 strikeouts over 74 innings, putting him on track to finish near 100 innings if he stays in this role. Long-term, it’s possible the Blue Jays stretch him out as a starter, but he’s also showing legitimate upside in these shorter stints. Miles’ sinker, especially against right-handed hitters, is an incredible weapon.

This season has been defined by bad news and disappointments, but Miles is one of the shining lights. Finding Miles in the Rule 5 Draft, a 25-year-old who’d thrown just 14 2/3 innings around elbow and back surgeries, was like winning the player development lottery for this organization.
items.titleZh: 克莱门特十局下打破僵局，蓝鸟交易截止日后势头不减
items.summaryZh: 克莱门特十局下开轰，蓝鸟加时胜太空人。
bodyZh: 休斯顿——尽管赔率对他们极为不利，但在交易截止日过后，蓝鸟并没有躺平。
周三他们经过加时赛以5比4战胜太空人，凭借厄尼·克莱门特在第十局上的本垒打，赢下了对美联西区领头羊的系列赛。蓝鸟仍然有一座大山要翻越，但如果他们要翻越，总得从某处开始。
以下是最重要的几点：
1. 厄尼·克莱门特在加时赛中挺身而出
克莱门特挥棒相当精彩，他在第十局上半局面对第一球就果断出棒，将球轰出左外野墙外，这是一记毫无疑问的本垒打。这正是蓝鸟需要更多的那种挥棒——能够瞬间抹去所有问题的制胜一击。
亨特·布朗带着无安打比赛进入第六局，随后迈尔斯·斯特劳用一支二垒安打打破了无安打局面，延续了他本赛季最佳的一段表现。赫苏斯·桑切斯随后用一支右外野方向的大号两分炮跟进，蓝鸟希望在八月和九月从他身上看到更多这样的表现。
“今年大部分时间表现一直起伏不定，”主教练约翰·施奈德说。“不仅仅是个人，整个团队也是如此。知道我们这里有哪些球员，我们在想办法如何能产生一些进攻火力。我们不是说，‘嘿，迈尔斯·斯特劳，八月来打十支本垒打吧。’而是要利用每个人的特长，找出最好的方式。”
蓝鸟的很多问题都可以通过力量来解决。最快捷的路径是弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗二世状态的复苏，他因腿筋有些紧绷而未出现在周三的先发阵容中，但蓝鸟的火力不足已经渗透到整个阵容。如果这支球队要在冲刺阶段创造奇迹，它就需要大胆挥棒、大胆冒险。周三就是一个很好的例子，说明一次关键的挥棒可以让你忘记比赛中其他无数次挥棒。
2. 詹姆斯·泰隆仍需努力
詹姆斯·泰隆开局不久就遇到了大量强劲击球，他先是被攻占满垒但化解了第一局没有失分，但最终何塞·奥图维轰出了一发。那之后，太空人就在泰隆身上打开了局面。
“投好球很重要，控球也很重要。这和[肖恩]比伯的情况类似，只是多了几样球路，”施奈德说。“当你把球投到想要的位置并很好地混合球路时，你就有很大机会。打击本身就很难。克里斯·巴塞特有些不同，到他这个生涯阶段可能已经会投12种球路了。但对詹姆斯来说，要了解自己的优势。如果比赛中需要依赖一两种球路，那就尽管用。”
泰隆投了四局失三分，虽然不算出色，但最近特雷·耶塞维奇受伤，这让泰隆有望留在轮换中。斯潘塞·阿里盖蒂周四在3A水牛城进行康复赛，但即便他很快重返大联盟，蓝鸟在耶塞维奇受伤前也一直渴望转向六人轮换，这为坚持那套计划提供了另一个机会，至少短期内是这样。
3. 值得关注：斯潘塞·迈尔斯
迈尔斯在第六局下半局面临无人出局、二三垒有人的局面。随后两次无关痛痒的界外高飞球和一次三振，他成功化解了危机。在这个属于迈尔斯的精彩赛季里，他不断证明自己还有更多潜力。
迈尔斯目前的防御率为3.04，在74局中投出71次三振，如果继续担任这个角色，他有望投到接近100局。长期来看，蓝鸟可能会把他培养为先发投手，但他在这些较短局数中也展现出了真正的上升空间。迈尔斯的伸卡球，尤其是面对右打者时，是一件不可思议的武器。
这个赛季被坏消息和失望所定义，但迈尔斯是闪耀的亮点之一。在规则5选秀中找到迈尔斯——一个25岁、因肘部手术和背部手术只投过14 2/3局的球员——对于这支球队来说就像赢得了球员发展彩票。

items.titleEn: Heads-up deke fools AL MVP frontrunner at a very opportune time for Blue Jays
bodyEn: Andrés Giménez made a potential game-saving play against the AL MVP frontrunner in Wednesday’s 5-4 Blue Jays win over the Astros.

With Toronto leading 5-3 in the bottom of the 10th inning, Yordan Alvarez, the best hitter in baseball this season, drilled a ball down the right-field line to plate one run. It looked like he had a potential double, but Blue Jays right fielder Nathan Lukes made a great throw to second, where Giménez made an incredible heads-up play.

As Alvarez neared second base, the Blue Jays shortstop faked like the ball wasn’t coming to the bag yet -- when it was actually mere feet away. That split-second decision caused Alvarez to go in standing up and Giménez promptly tagged him out, recording the first out of the inning and clearing the bases.

“We're sitting there talking about ‘do you walk Yordan or not?’ You're sitting there with a Hall of Famer on deck [Jose Altuve], swinging the bat well,” Blue Jays manager John Schneider said. “So, really, really good play from Lukes to get it in, and it was kind of a no-way moment, you know, with Gimé, he deked him there. Kind of caught a break, but that's extra innings, you got to catch a break. But great throw, great tag.”
Alvarez said afterward that he thought he missed the base and credited Giménez for the deceit.

“Players tend to do those types of tricks,” Alvarez said. “What really happened was I was trying to get as fast as I could to get to the base and when I lifted my head up to see in front of me [he was at the base].”
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟关键假动作骗过美联MVP热门
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟利用巧妙假动作在关键时刻骗过美联MVP热门，赢得比赛。
bodyZh: 在周三蓝鸟以5-4战胜太空人的比赛中，Andrés Giménez 对美联MVP热门人选做出了一次可能拯救比赛的防守。
多伦多在第十局下半以5-3领先，本赛季最好的击球手 Yordan Alvarez 将球击向右外野边线，送回一分。这看起来可能是一支二垒安打，但蓝鸟右外野手 Nathan Lukes 做出了精彩的传球到二垒，Giménez 在那里做出了令人难以置信的机智防守。
当 Alvarez 接近二垒时，蓝鸟游击手假装球还没传到垒包——实际上球距离只有几英尺远。这一瞬间的决定让 Alvarez 减速站立跑垒，Giménez 迅速对其进行触杀，完成了该局第一个出局，并清空了垒包。
“我们坐在那里讨论‘要不要保送 Yordan？’而下一棒是名人堂级别的打者 Jose Altuve，他挥棒状态很好，”蓝鸟主教练 John Schneider 说。“所以，Lukes 的传球真的非常非常好，而且那是一个不可思议的时刻，你知道，Gimé 在那里假动作骗了他。算是抓住了一个机会，但这就是延长赛，你必须抓住机会。但传球很棒，触杀也很棒。”
Alvarez 赛后表示，他以为自己错过了垒包，并称赞了 Giménez 的骗术。
“球员们往往会做这类小动作，”Alvarez 说。“实际发生的是，我试图尽快到达垒包，当我抬头看前方时（他已经站在垒包上了）。”
items.author: Brent Maguire

items.titleEn: Yesavage (left knee inflammation) placed on IL after MRI imaging
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- Trey Yesavage has been placed on the 15-day IL with left knee inflammation after he left Tuesday night’s game against the Astros during his warmup for the third inning.

Most injuries feel surprising in the moment, but this one particularly so. Yesavage was throwing his usual warmup pitches when he landed awkwardly on his lead leg and his left knee appeared to buckle. He tried another pitch, which still looked unsteady, and that brought manager John Schneider and the Blue Jays’ trainer racing out from the dugout.
After one more pitch, Yesavage shook his head and walked off with his manager.
“Trey felt a little pinch there in his left knee on his first couple of warmup pitches in the third,” Schneider said after Tuesday’s loss. “He said he was OK, but we’re not taking any chances.”
The Blue Jays received MRI results just prior to Wednesday’s game, showing inflammation in the knee, and he’ll be shut down from throwing off the mound for now.

In Yesavage’s place, Lazaro Estrada is back up with the big club after recently being optioned. He’ll slide into a bulk role in the bullpen as the Blue Jays still have five starters, back to a standard rotation for the time being. Prior to Tuesday’s game, Schneider shared plans to move to a six-man rotation with Dylan Cease, Yesavage, José Soriano, Max Scherzer, Shane Bieber and Jameson Taillon, but those plans lasted just two innings.
items.titleZh: MRI确认左膝炎症，Yesavage进入伤病名单
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟投手Yesavage因左膝炎症进入15天伤病名单，Estrada顶替。
bodyZh: 休斯敦——在周二晚上对阵太空人队的比赛中，Trey Yesavage在第三局热身时离场，此后因左膝炎症被列入15天伤病名单。
大多数伤病发生时都令人意外，但这次尤其如此。Yesavage正在如常投热身球，他前导腿落地姿势别扭，左膝似乎弯曲了一下。他又试投了一球，看起来仍然不稳，这使主教练John Schneider和蓝鸟队训练师从休息区冲了出来。
又投了一球后，Yesavage摇了摇头，和主教练一起走下场。
Schneider在周二失利后表示：“Trey在第三局最初几个热身球时感到左膝有些刺痛。他说他没事，但我们不想冒险。”
蓝鸟队在周三比赛前收到了MRI结果，显示膝盖有炎症，他将暂时暂停在投手丘上投球。

顶替Yesavage的是Lazaro Estrada，他在最近被下放后重新回到大联盟。他将进入牛棚承担长中继角色，因为蓝鸟队目前仍有五名先发投手，暂时回到常规轮值。在周二比赛前，Schneider还曾计划转向六人先发轮值，包括Dylan Cease、Yesavage、José Soriano、Max Scherzer、Shane Bieber和Jameson Taillon，但这一计划只维持了两局。

items.titleEn: Where does Okamoto land in latest Rookie of the Year poll?
bodyEn: With less than two months left in the regular season, how tight are the Rookie of the Year Award races?
Well, according to the votes cast by our MLB.com experts, the National League race can't possibly get any tighter. That's because there's a two-man tie at the top.
Matters in the American League are much clearer as the rookie who has been in the lead there since June seems to be strengthening his position.
Thirty MLB.com experts based their ROY picks not only on the results to date, but how they think the rest of the season will unfold.
Voters ranked their top five picks in each league on a 5-4-3-2-1 scale, with five points awarded for a first-place vote, four points for a second-place vote and so on. Here are the results.
All stats updated through Monday.
AMERICAN LEAGUE
1. Kevin McGonigle, Tigers (170 total vote points, 24 first-place votes)

With Tarik Skubal now wearing Dodger blue, a new era of Detroit baseball is dawning. The 21-year-old McGonigle looks like the face of it. He undoubtedly will be if he keeps producing like he has through his first 108 career games. With more walks than strikeouts, McGonigle's plate approach belies his youth. He is tied with James Wood with a .393 on-base percentage. His 136 wRC+ is tied with Mike Trout and Byron Buxton, and his 4.5 FanGraphs WAR ranks sixth among position players. McGonigle's point total in these monthly polls has increased from 120 in June to 123 in July to 170 now.
2. Munetaka Murakami, White Sox (138 total vote points, 11 first-place votes)

Murakami was crushing the ball before he landed on the injured list with a right hamstring strain. After about six weeks on the shelf, he returned on July 10 -- and continued crushing. The lefty slugger has gone deep four times and recorded an .883 OPS in 19 games since his activation. No qualified rookie has more long balls (24) or a better OPS (.921) this year. Expect Murakami's bat to make a lot more loud noises over the duration of the season; no qualified hitter has a higher hard-hit rate (59.5%).
3. Parker Messick, Guardians (120 total vote points, 2 first-place votes)

Opposing batters know they are going to get a hefty dose of four-seam fastballs when they face Messick. But they can't hit it. That pitch has produced a .161 average, a .233 slugging percentage and a 34.3% strikeout rate. According to Statcast's pitching run value metric, Messick's heater is the second-most valuable pitch in MLB, just behind Jacob Misiorowski's four-seamer. It's been integral to the southpaw's success through 22 starts. He has the seventh-best ERA among qualified hurlers (2.57).
4. Kazuma Okamoto, Blue Jays (40 total vote points, 1 first-place vote)

Okamoto, like countryman Murakami, is in a tie atop the rookie home run leaderboard with 24 dingers, although he has left the yard just twice in his past 19 games. He has been, by far, the Blue Jays' best run producer and leads AL rookies in RBIs (69) and total bases (180). Okamoto's 39 extra-base hits are one behind the Royals' Carter Jensen for the junior circuit rookie lead.
5. Payton Tolle, Red Sox (31 total vote points)

Tolle hasn't thrown quite enough innings to qualify for the ERA title, but if he had, his strikeout-minus-walk rate (19.5%) would sit 19th in the Majors, right between Nathan Eovaldi and Bryan Woo. Over his past five starts, the Red Sox left-hander has struck out 36 batters across 26 2/3 innings and has issued only six walks. Tolle's 3.30 ERA in 101 frames is certainly solid, but because of his ability to get K's, limit walks and induce a decent amount of soft contact, his expected ERA is even better (2.98).

Others receiving votes: Chase DeLauter (Guardians), Travis Bazzana (Guardians), Tristan Peters (White Sox), Samuel Basallo (Orioles), Jake Bennett (Red Sox), Carter Jensen (Royals), Sam Antonacci (White Sox), Walbert Ureña (Angels), Trey Yesavage (Blue Jays)
NATIONAL LEAGUE
1-T. JJ Wetherholt, Cardinals (144 total vote points, 19 first-place votes)1-T. Sal Stewart, Reds (144 total vote points, 17 first-place votes)

Look at that -- 144 to 144. Wetherholt gets top billing because of his edge in first-place votes, but after placing second in this poll in each of the past two months, Stewart has knotted things up thanks to a strong July (seven home runs, .510 slugging percentage). He leads all NL rookies -- and is up among the MLB leaders -- in several offensive categories, including RBIs (85, tied for first) homers (24, tied for sixth), and extra-base hits (47, 12th).

Wetherholt's 16 dingers are the second-most among NL rookies, but he does much more than slug. He sits in the 95th percentile of MLB in baserunning run value (+4), and he has the Majors' second-highest fielding run value (+18). Wetherholt's all-around game has made him one of just 11 position players with at least 4.0 fWAR. So even while he slumped at the plate in July (.675), the 23-year-old still provided plenty of value.
3. Nolan McLean, Mets (100 total vote points)

After some bumpy outings in May and June, McLean was brilliant in July, allowing a total of six earned runs in his five starts. He lasted at least six innings each time out and recorded 35 strikeouts next to nine walks. McLean, who owns a 3.29 ERA in 22 starts, ranks fifth in the bigs with 148 strikeouts. A healthy amount of those K's have come on his fantastic sinker. Opposing hitters have a .176 average and a .261 slugging percentage through 210 plate appearances ending on that two-seamer this season.
4. TJ Rumfield, Rockies (57 total vote points)

There was a 33-game stretch from June 10 through July 18 when Rumfield was one of the big leagues' hottest hitters. He slashed .372/.453/.620 in 139 plate appearances. He hit six homers during that span, the last of which traveled a Statcast-projected 456 feet. Even though he hasn't been quite as productive of late, Rumfield is pacing all qualified NL rookies with his .296 average, .376 OBP and .841 OPS.
5. Foster Griffin, Guardians (50 total vote points)
Well, this is awkward.

Many of our experts cast their ballots before Monday's Trade Deadline, when Griffin was dealt from the Nationals to the Guardians. Although he will end up spending only four months in the NL, Griffin could still receive some decent down-ballot support for Rookie of the Year after the season. The All-Star left-hander ranks seventh or better among qualified senior circuit pitchers in ERA (3.06), WHIP (1.07), innings pitched (129 1/3) and walks-per-nine rate (2.09).

Others receiving votes: Esmerlyn Valdez (Pirates), Carson Benge (Mets), A.J. Ewing (Mets), Joe Mack (Marlins), Konnor Griffin (Pirates), Cole Carrigg (Rockies), Bryce Eldridge (Giants), Logan Henderson (Brewers), Owen Caissie (Marlins)
items.titleZh: Okamoto在最新年度最佳新秀投票中排名第几？
items.summaryZh: MLB.com最新年度最佳新秀票选，Okamoto在美联排名第四。
bodyZh: 常规赛还剩不到两个月，年度最佳新秀奖的竞争有多激烈？
嗯，根据我们的MLB.com专家的投票结果，国家联盟的竞争已经不可能更激烈了，因为榜首有两人并列。
美国联盟的情况则明朗得多，自6月以来一直领跑的新秀似乎正在巩固自己的位置。
30位MLB.com专家在选择最佳新秀时，不仅依据了目前的结果，也依据他们对剩余赛季走势的判断。
投票者按5-4-3-2-1的积分制排列每个联盟的前五选择，第一选票得5分，第二选票得4分，依此类推。以下是结果。
所有统计数据已更新至周一。
美国联盟
1. Kevin McGonigle，老虎队（总积分170分，第一选票24张）

随着Tarik Skubal如今身披道奇蓝，底特律棒球的新纪元正在开启。21岁的McGonigle看起来就是它的门面。如果他继续像生涯前108场比赛那样产出，那他无疑将是。他的保送次数多于三振数，这样的打击纪律让人忘记了他的年轻。他以.393的上垒率与James Wood并列。他的136 wRC+与Mike Trout和Byron Buxton持平，他的4.5 FanGraphs WAR在所有位置球员中排名第六。McGonigle在这些月度投票中的得分从6月的120分、7月的123分上升到现在的170分。
2. Munetaka Murakami，白袜队（总积分138分，第一选票11张）
Murakami在因右腿筋拉伤进入伤病名单之前，打击状态火爆。缺阵大约六周后，他在7月10日复出——继续火爆。这位左打重炮手在复出后的19场比赛中轰出4发本垒打，OPS达到.883。本赛季没有有资格的新秀比他打出更多本垒打（24支），也没有人拥有比他更高的OPS（.921）。预计在赛季剩余时间里，Murakami的球棒还会制造出更多响亮的声音；所有有资格的打者中，他的强击率（59.5%）为最高。
3. Parker Messick，守护者队（总积分120分，第一选票2张）
对手打者知道面对Messick时会吃到大量四缝线速球。但他们就是打不好。这一球种让对手平均打击率只有.161，长打率.233，三振率达到34.3%。根据Statcast的投球跑分价值指标，Messick的速球是MLB中价值第二高的球种，仅次于Jacob Misiorowski的四缝线速球。这是他这位左投在22场先发中取得成功的关键。他在合格投手中自责分率排名第七（2.57）。
4. Kazuma Okamoto，蓝鸟队（总积分40分，第一选票1张）
与同胞Murakami一样，Okamoto以24发本垒打并列新秀本垒打榜首位，尽管他最近19场比赛只有两次轰出本垒打。他是蓝鸟队迄今为止最出色的打点制造者，在美联新秀中打点（69）和总垒数（180）均领跑。Okamoto的39支长打落后皇家队的Carter Jensen一支，排在美联新秀第二位。
5. Payton Tolle，红袜队（总积分31分）

Tolle目前的投球局数还不够多，未能进入自责分率排行榜的评选资格，但如果他达到了，他的三振率减保送率（19.5%）将排在大联盟第19位，恰好位于Nathan Eovaldi和Bryan Woo之间。在最近五场先发中，这位红袜左投在26 2/3局里三振了36名打者，只送出六个保送。Tolle在101局中自责分率3.30确实不错，但由于他能够三振、控制保送并制造一定的软接触，他的预期自责分率更佳（2.98）。
其他获得选票的球员：Chase DeLauter（守护者队）、Travis Bazzana（守护者队）、Tristan Peters（白袜队）、Samuel Basallo（金莺队）、Jake Bennett（红袜队）、Carter Jensen（皇家队）、Sam Antonacci（白袜队）、Walbert Ureña（天使队）、Trey Yesavage（蓝鸟队）
国家联盟
1-T. JJ Wetherholt，红雀队（总积分144分，第一选票19张）1-T. Sal Stewart，红人队（总积分144分，第一选票17张）
看看这个——144比144。Wetherholt因第一选票优势而排名更靠前，但Stewart在过去两个月的投票中都位居第二，如今凭借7月的出色表现（7发本垒打，.510长打率）追平了比分。他在多项进攻数据上领跑所有国联新秀，同时也排在大联盟领先者之中，包括打点（85，并列第一）、本垒打（24，并列第六）和长打（47，第12）。
Wetherholt的16发本垒打排名国联新秀第二，但他能做的远不止长打。他在MLB的跑垒跑分价值（+4）中排名第95百分位，并且拥有全大联盟第二高的防守跑分价值（+18）。Wetherholt的全能表现使他成为仅有的11位fWAR至少达到4.0的位置球员之一。因此，即使他在7月的打击表现下滑（.675），这位23岁的球员仍然提供了大量价值。
3. Nolan McLean，大都会队（总积分100分）
在5月和6月经历了一些动荡的先发后，McLean在7月表现出色，五次先发合计仅失六分自责分。他每一次先发都至少投满六局，并送出35次三振和九次保送。McLean在22场先发中自责分率为3.29，以148次三振排名大联盟第五。那些三振中有相当一部分来自他那出色的伸卡球。本赛季面对这种二缝线速球，对手打者在210个打席中的平均打击率为.176，长打率为.261。
4. TJ Rumfield，洛矶队（总积分57分）
从6月10日到7月18日，有33场比赛期间，Rumfield是大联盟最火热的打者之一。他在139个打席中打出了.372/.453/.620的打击三围。这段期间他击出六支本垒打，其中最后一支被Statcast预测飞了456英尺。尽管最近状态并不那么出色，但Rumfield仍以.296的打击率、.376的上垒率和.841的OPS领先所有有资格的国联新秀。
5. Foster Griffin，守护者队（总积分50分）
嗯，这有点尴尬。
我们的许多专家在周一交易截止日期之前投出了选票，当时Griffin刚从国民队被交易到守护者队。尽管他最终只会在国家联盟待四个月，但Griffin仍可能在赛季后获得一些不错的下位选票支持，竞争年度最佳新秀。这位全明星左投在合格国联投手中，自责分率（3.06）、WHIP（1.07）、投球局数（129 1/3）和每九局保送率（2.09）等数据均排名第七或更好。
其他获得选票的球员：Esmerlyn Valdez（海盗队）、Carson Benge（大都会队）、A.J. Ewing（大都会队）、Joe Mack（马林鱼队）、Konnor Griffin（海盗队）、Cole Carrigg（洛矶队）、Bryce Eldridge（巨人队）、Logan Henderson（酿酒人队）、Owen Caissie（马林鱼队）

items.titleEn: These Deadline movers may benefit from joining new teams
bodyEn: The 2026 Trade Deadline has come and gone, and it had no shortage of intrigue. From stunners like the Adley Rutschman and José Soriano deals to Tarik Subal and everything in between, the sprint to October will be heavily impacted.

Many of the names traded may be in line for better results down the stretch, too. Whether it’s a better fit with their new club, a new ballpark or simply a better chance to play, here are seven Trade Deadline movers who stand to gain from their new digs.
RHP Clay Holmes, CubsTrade details:Cubs get: RHP Clay Holmes, OF Tyrone TaylorMets get: INF Jefferson Rojas

Former Mets teammate turned Cubs contemporary David Peterson can attest: Putting the ball on the ground in front of this Chicago defense is a good way to live. The Cubs lead MLB in Fielding Run Value overall and are second to only the Cardinals across the infield, making Holmes’ 55.3% ground-ball rate this season an excellent fit.

Peterson -- with a 49.5% ground-ball rate -- has allowed no more than two runs in five of six outings since being traded. Holmes had already turned in a 2.39 ERA across nine starts with the Mets this season, and there’s reason to believe he can replicate strong results in Chicago when he returns from a fractured right fibula. He’s currently slated to make his Cubs debut in Kansas City this weekend.
OF Heliot Ramos, YankeesTrade details:Yankees get: OF Heliot RamosGiants get: LHP Henry Lalane, IF Kaeden Kent

There’s big pop in Ramos’ bat, with more than 20 home runs in each of the past two years. He should get plenty of run in pinstripes, but the Yankees especially need him to dominate left-handed pitching. Ramos has a career .845 OPS when facing the platoon advantage.

Those power numbers could get even better at Yankee Stadium. Statcast shows a projected 13 homers this season for Ramos if he played all of his games in the Bronx, compared to nine actual long balls. The ability to go to the short porch in the opposite field is a key reason why. Ramos, after all, is the only right-handed batter to ever deposit a ball into McCovey Cove.
RHP José Soriano, Blue JaysTrade details:Blue Jays get: RHP José SorianoAngels get: SS Arjun Nimmala, OF Eddie Micheletti, RHP Angel Rivero
Soriano has taken a step back after cruising to an 0.84 ERA through his first seven starts, but a 3.29 ERA over 22 total starts with a 24.9% strikeout rate is nothing to complain about.

Much like Holmes, Soriano has a knack for putting the ball on the ground (52.3%). The Toronto infield doesn’t rate quite as highly as the Cubs’ this season (13th in FRV), but it’s a big step up from the Angels’ place in 24th. The Blue Jays helped Dylan Cease realize his ace potential, and Soriano could be next. He’s additionally under club control through 2028.
RHP Freddy Peralta, RaysTrade details:Rays get: RHP Freddy PeraltaMets get: OF Aidan Smith, RHP Gary Gill Hill, INF Émilien Pitre

The Rays made a bet that “Fastball Freddy” can get back to his old self, better than the 2026 version that had a 4.99 ERA before his trade. Tuesday’s debut wasn’t a great start to this partnership, but Tampa Bay may be the perfect organization with which he can right the ship.

Peralta’s changeup has been a strong complement to the four-seamer in the past, but it’s been hit hard this season. This year’s Rays love the changeup. They’ve thrown it 21% of the time, more than any other team has thrown changeups in the Statcast era (2015). Maybe Tampa Bay can find a tweak to key better results for Peralta.
RHP River Ryan, TigersTrade details:Tigers get: OF Zyhir Hope, RHP River Ryan and RHP Brady SmithDodgers get: LHP Tarik Skubal

Skubal was the obvious headliner of the entire Deadline. Ryan, however, should not be slept on. MLB Pipeline’s No. 68 prospect, Ryan is a hard thrower who started his professional career as a two-way player, shifting to the mound full time in 2022. He made a blistering MLB debut in 2024 with a 1.33 ERA in four starts but then missed 2025 after Tommy John surgery.

Ryan’s stuff -- a two-seamer, cutter, slider, curveball and changeup to complement the four-seamer -- certainly looked to be back this year before going on the shelf with a hamstring strain. He had a 2.81 ERA in his first seven Triple-A starts this year. Now in Detroit, Ryan should finally get his long-term shot at a rotation spot.
RHP Antonio Senzatela, BrewersTrade details:Brewers get: RHP Antonio SenzatelaRockies get: LHP Mark Manfredi, SS Juan Martinez

The 31-year-old Senzatela found something after converting to the bullpen this season. He had a sub-2.00 ERA through mid-June and has struck out opponents at a 20.7% rate, much higher than his 15% career average. He’s also seen a 2.3 mph increase in four-seam velocity over his previous career-high. A new cutter (29.5% usage) has helped, too.

In total, Senzatela’s 3.54 ERA is marked improvement, and he’ll offer multi-inning capability that appeals to the Brewers. Even better news lies in his home/road splits. Senzatela had a 2.57 ERA in 18 road appearances compared to a 4.81 ERA in 16 outings in hitter-friendly Coors Field. Milwaukee additionally has a fantastic reputation for developing pitchers, so there could be more in the tank.
IF Marcelo Mayer, GiantsTrade details:Giants get: INF Marcelo MayerRed Sox get: LHP Erik Miller, OF Carlos Gutierrez

Much like the Tigers’ situation with Ryan, it will be interesting to see if Mayer can prove himself with a clear path to playing time in San Francisco. The No. 4 overall pick in 2021 and a former top-15 prospect in baseball, Mayer has battled injuries and had to work at multiple positions in his first two seasons in the big leagues. He’s batted just .223 with a .624 OPS.

But there’s still plenty of talent in the 23-year-old. Mayer, currently on the IL with a stress reaction in his left ulna, should have a chance to be the Giants’ everyday second baseman when healthy after Luis Arraez was dealt to the Phillies.
items.titleZh: 交易截止日球员或受益于新东家
items.summaryZh: 交易截止日七位转队球员或受益于新球队。
bodyZh: 2026年交易截止日已经过去，其中不乏引人注目之处。从Adley Rutschman和José Soriano的交易这样的惊人之举，到Tarik Subal以及介于两者之间的所有交易，向十月冲刺的进程将受到重大影响。
许多被交易的球员在收官阶段也可能取得更好的成绩。无论是更好地融入新球队、新的球场，还是仅仅是更多的出场机会，以下是七位可能从新东家受益的交易截止日球员。
右投手 Clay Holmes，小熊队交易详情：小熊队得到右投手 Clay Holmes、外野手 Tyrone Taylor；大都会队得到内野手 Jefferson Rojas。
前大都会队友、现在小熊队的 David Peterson 可以证明：在这支芝加哥防守面前把球打在地上是一种不错的生存方式。小熊队在全联盟的防守跑动值（Fielding Run Value）中排名第一，内野防守仅次于红雀队，这使得 Holmes 本赛季55.3%的地滚球率非常适合。
Peterson——地滚球率49.5%——在被交易后的六次出场中有五次失分不超过两分。Holmes 本赛季在大都会队九场先发中已经取得了2.39的自责分率，我们有理由相信他在右腓骨骨折复出后能在芝加哥复制强劲的表现。他预计本周末在堪萨斯城上演小熊队首秀。
外野手 Heliot Ramos，洋基队交易详情：洋基队得到外野手 Heliot Ramos；巨人队得到左投手 Henry Lalane、内野手 Kaeden Kent。
Ramos 的球棒威力巨大，过去两年每年都打出超过20支本垒打。他应该能在条纹衫中获得大量出场机会，但洋基队尤其需要他压制左投。职业生涯中，Ramos 在面对左投手时的OPS为.845。
这些力量数据在洋基球场可能会更好。Statcast 显示，如果 Ramos 本赛季所有比赛都在布朗克斯进行，预计能打出13支本垒打，而实际只有9支。能够将球打向右外野的短围栏是关键原因。毕竟，Ramos 是唯一一位将球打进麦考维湾的右打者。
右投手 José Soriano，蓝鸟队交易详情：蓝鸟队得到右投手 José Soriano；天使队得到游击手 Arjun Nimmala、外野手 Eddie Micheletti、右投手 Angel Rivero。
Soriano 在职业生涯前七场先发中交出了0.84的自责分率后有所退步，但他在22场先发中总计3.29的自责分率和24.9%的三振率也没什么可抱怨的。
与 Holmes 非常相似，Soriano 擅长让球落地（52.3%）。多伦多内野防守本赛季的评分不如小熊队（防守跑动值排名第13），但相比天使队的第24名已有大幅提升。蓝鸟队帮助 Dylan Cease 发挥出了王牌潜力，Soriano 可能是下一个。此外，他在2028年前都受球队控制。
右投手 Freddy Peralta，光芒队交易详情：光芒队得到右投手 Freddy Peralta；大都会队得到外野手 Aidan Smith、右投手 Gary Gill Hill、内野手 Émilien Pitre。
光芒队赌了一把，相信“Fastball Freddy”能找回原来的自己，比2026年版本（交易前自责分率4.99）更好。周二的首秀并不是这段合作的良好开端，但坦帕湾可能是他扭转局面的完美球队。
Peralta 的变速球过去一直与四缝线速球形成很好的互补，但本赛季却被对手打得厉害。今年的光芒队非常喜欢变速球。他们投变速球的比例达到21%，是 Statcast 时代（2015年）以来所有球队中最高的。也许坦帕湾能找到调整方法，为 Peralta 带来更好的结果。
右投手 River Ryan，老虎队交易详情：老虎队得到外野手 Zyhir Hope、右投手 River Ryan 和右投手 Brady Smith；道奇队得到左投手 Tarik Skubal。
Skubal 显然是整个交易截止日的头条人物。然而，Ryan 也不应被忽视。作为 MLB Pipeline 排名第68位的潜力新秀，Ryan 是一名强力投手，职业生涯初期是二刀流球员，2022年才全职转投手。他在2024年以四场先发1.33的自责分率迎来惊艳的大联盟首秀，但在接受汤米约翰手术后缺席了2025赛季。
Ryan 的球种——包括二缝线速球、切球、滑球、曲线球和变速球，以及四缝线速球——在今年因腿筋拉伤缺阵前看起来确实恢复了。他今年前七场三A先发自责分率为2.81。现在在底特律，Ryan 终于有望获得长期先发轮值位置。
右投手 Antonio Senzatela，酿酒人队交易详情：酿酒人队得到右投手 Antonio Senzatela；洛矶队得到左投手 Mark Manfredi、游击手 Juan Martinez。
31岁的 Senzatela 本赛季转战牛棚后找到了状态。截至六月中旬，他的自责分率低于2.00，三振率为20.7%，远高于职业生涯平均的15%。他的四缝线速球球速也比之前职业生涯最高值提高了2.3英里/小时。新练的切球（使用率29.5%）也有所帮助。
总体而言，Senzatela 的3.54自责分率是显著进步，他将提供对酿酒人有吸引力的多局投球能力。更好的消息在于他的主客场差异。Senzatela 在18场客场比赛中自责分率为2.57，而在有利于打者的库尔斯球场出场的16场比赛中自责分率为4.81。此外，密尔沃基在培养投手方面享有盛誉，所以他可能还有更多潜力可挖。
内野手 Marcelo Mayer，巨人队交易详情：巨人队得到内野手 Marcelo Mayer；红袜队得到左投手 Erik Miller、外野手 Carlos Gutierrez。
与老虎队和 Ryan 的情况类似，值得关注的是 Mayer 能否在旧金山获得明确的出场时间并证明自己。作为2021年选秀第4顺位和曾经的全美前15潜力新秀，Mayer 一直与伤病作斗争，并在大联盟的前两个赛季中不得不兼顾多个位置。他的打击率仅为.223，OPS为.624。
但这位23岁的球员仍天赋满满。目前因左尺骨应力反应进入伤病名单的 Mayer，在 Luis Arraez 被交易到费城人后，健康时应该有机会成为巨人队的常规二垒手。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays fall off track vs. Astros after Yesavage's early exit
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- It was all going so well until manager John Schneider and the Blue Jays’ trainer bolted from the dugout before the bottom of the third inning.
Once Trey Yesavage left the game early with left knee discomfort, the Blue Jays quickly crumbled against a stronger Astros team and lost, 7-2, to fall to 53-61.

“Trey felt a little pinch there in his left knee on his first couple of warmup pitches in the third,” Schneider said. “He said he was OK, but we’re not taking any chances. He’s going to get an MRI tomorrow, and we’ll see where we’re at.”
This is what mattered most:
1. Yesavage’s injury led to a long night
When you’re planning on six-plus innings out of your starter and only get two, it’s not going to be a good night.

Chad Dallas looked sharp early on, but the Astros eventually got to him, and Taylor Trammell broke the game open with a three-run shot in the fifth. This was a difficult outing for Dallas, but given the openings in Toronto’s bullpen, he should continue to see plenty of innings down the stretch.

“I thought he threw the ball well. He picked us up exactly how we needed him to with Trey coming out early,” Schneider said. “It was a lot to ask of him, throwing that many pitches. He’s done that before, but I think it was a couple of weird plays with two outs there in the fourth that led to the first runs.”

Early setbacks and early deficits just further highlight this offense’s struggles, too. The Blue Jays are the lowest-scoring team in baseball this season, and unless something changes quickly, they’re not built to come from behind.
2. What’s gotten into Myles Straw?

Straw ripped a double off the wall in left field, then followed that with a triple into the gap, one of his best offensive days of the season. This comes after a double and a stolen base in a two-hit day in the opener.

Straw is always one of the first on the field for early batting practice each afternoon, and if you watch those sessions, there’s some real pop in Straw’s swing. More than you’d expect from someone with 13 home runs over 800 career games, at least, as he’s put an emphasis on swinging harder over the past year.
He’ll have plenty of playing time in center now after Daulton Varsho was dealt to the Astros, and Schneider is looking to Straw to help keep the clubhouse together after the Trade Deadline upheaval.

“I always say it takes time for a personality to come in and feel like they’ve been here,” Schneider said. “Some of the guys we brought in have an immediate presence. It’s an opportunity for guys who have been here to take a step forward. We’re talking about guys that have done it like George [Springer] and Vlad[imir Guerrero Jr.]. It’s an opportunity for Ernie Clement, [Alejandro] Kirk, Myles. I always say that Myles is a bit of the behind-the-scenes glue guy. It’s different. It takes time to feel that out.”
3. Jameson Taillon getting a shot in the Blue Jays’ rotation
Before the game, Schneider shared that they’d be moving to a six-man rotation, allowing Taillon to join the group instead of pitching in a bulk role.

Well, that lasted two innings until Yesavage’s injury, but Taillon’s role remains. Taillon met with the media for the first time since the trade pregame Tuesday, an engaging and thoughtful session about his struggles with the Cubs in 2026 and what he hopes to change.

“I’ve given up a lot of home runs this year,” Taillon said. “Mental-game wise, I got to a point where I was pitching timid, and that’s not me. I was just thinking about the worst-case scenario sometimes. I’d want to get ahead, but I didn’t want to leak it towards the middle and give up another home run. I was out there with those thoughts, and that’s just a horrible place to be. That’s the human side. Getting to take a step back and take a fresh start, I want to get back to who I am. That’s filling up the zone with six pitches and being super aggressive.”

The Blue Jays had serious interest in Taillon four years ago when he was a free agent. If he can get back on track in August and September, perhaps that interest is rekindled to fill a short-term need in 2027.
items.titleZh: 耶萨维奇提前离场，蓝鸟不敌太空人
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟先发耶萨维奇因膝伤提前退场，球队2-7不敌太空人。
bodyZh: 休斯顿——在第三局下半开始前，主教练约翰·施奈德和蓝鸟队训练师突然冲出休息区，此前一切原本进展顺利。
特雷·耶萨维奇因左膝不适提前离场后，蓝鸟队面对更强大的太空人队迅速崩盘，以2-7落败，战绩降至53胜61负。
“特雷在第三局最初几球热身时感到左膝有点刺痛，”施奈德说，“他说没事，但我们不想冒险。他明天将接受核磁共振检查，然后我们再看看情况。”
以下是最关键的内容：
1. 耶萨维奇的伤病导致了一个漫长的夜晚
当你指望先发投手投六局以上，却只得到两局时，这个夜晚不会好过。
查德·达拉斯开场表现不错，但太空人队最终找到了他的破绽，泰勒·特拉梅尔在第五局轰出三分炮，锁定胜局。对达拉斯来说这是一场艰难的比赛，但考虑到多伦多牛棚的空缺，他在赛季后半段应该会获得大量投球局数。
“我认为他投得很好。在特雷提前退场的情况下，他正是我们需要的那种顶替，”施奈德说，“让他投那么多球确实要求很高。他以前也做到过，但我觉得是第四局两出局后的一些怪异局面导致了首分。”
早早的挫折和落后也进一步凸显了这支球队进攻端的挣扎。蓝鸟队是本赛季大联盟得分最低的球队，除非迅速改变，否则他们并不擅长逆转。
2. 迈尔斯·斯特劳怎么了？
斯特劳击出一记左外野墙边的二垒打，随后又打出一支三垒安打，这是他本赛季进攻端表现最好的比赛之一。此前在揭幕战中，他曾有一支二垒打和一次盗垒的两安打表现。
斯特劳每天下午总是最早到场进行赛前打击训练的人之一，如果你看过那些训练，会发现他的挥棒确实有一些力量。至少比他在800场生涯比赛中只打出13支本垒打的人所预期的要多，因为过去一年他注重增加挥棒力度。
在道尔顿·瓦尔肖被交易到太空人队后，他将在中外野获得大量出场时间。施奈德也希望斯特劳能帮助球队在交易截止日的动荡后保持更衣室团结。
“我总说，一个人来到新环境需要时间才能有家的感觉，”施奈德说，“我们引进的一些人立刻就有了存在感。这是让原有球员向前迈进一步的机会。我们说的是像乔治（斯普林格）和弗拉迪（格雷罗二世）那样做到过的人。这也是厄尼·克莱门特、（亚历杭德罗）柯克、迈尔斯的机会。我常说迈尔斯是那种幕后黏合剂。这不一样，需要时间感受。”
3. 詹姆斯·泰隆获得蓝鸟先发轮值机会
赛前，施奈德透露球队将改用六人先发轮值，让泰隆加入轮值阵容，而不是担任长中继投手。
好吧，由于耶萨维奇的受伤，这套计划只维持了两局，但泰隆的角色保持不变。泰隆在周一交易后首次接受媒体采访，那是关于他在2026年在小熊队遭遇的困境以及他希望做出改变的深入而富有思考的交谈。
“今年我被打了很多本垒打，”泰隆说，“在心理层面，我一度投得畏手畏脚，那不是我。有时我只想着最坏的情况。我想取得球数领先，但又不想把球投到中路再被打一支本垒打。我带着这些想法上场，那是个可怕的状态。这是人性的一面。能够退一步重新开始，我想找回真实的自己。那就是用六种球路填满好球区，极具侵略性。”
四年前泰隆成为自由球员时，蓝鸟队曾对他产生浓厚兴趣。如果他在8月和9月重回正轨，也许这种兴趣会被重新点燃，以满足2027年的短期需求。

items.titleEn: Yesavage exits with left knee discomfort, will get MRI Wednesday
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- Trey Yesavage left Tuesday’s game in Houston with left knee discomfort, another blow to a Blue Jays team in need of some better breaks.
He is scheduled to undergo an MRI Wednesday, and the Blue Jays will reevaluate then.
Yesavage was throwing warmup pitches prior to the bottom of the third inning when suddenly, manager John Schneider and the Blue Jays’ trainer came jogging out of the dugout.

Schneider watched on as Yesavage threw one more warmup pitch, but Yesavage quickly shook his head and walked off the mound toward the dugout. Yesavage’s left knee, which is his landing leg, appeared to buckle underneath him when he was throwing his early warmup pitches. Chad Dallas entered the game in Yesavage’s place to begin the bottom of the third inning.

Following the 7-2 loss to the Astros, Schneider shared that Yesavage had felt a “pinch” in his left knee, and while Yesavage didn’t seem overly concerned, they weren’t about to take any chances with their young star.
“It was weird. It was kind of a pinching sensation where he couldn’t really stabilize perfectly,” Schneider said. “There was nothing beforehand. It kind of caught us off guard.”

Yesavage hadn’t allowed a hit over the first two frames and owns a 3.65 ERA over 93 2/3 innings, a young cornerstone in this rotation which has undergone significant changes in recent days. Just hours before Yesavage’s injury, Schneider shared the Blue Jays’ plans to move to a six-man rotation following the additions of Jameson Taillon from the Cubs and José Soriano from the Angels after Kevin Gausman was dealt.

Depth is not an immediate issue, especially with Spencer Arrighetti -- another Trade Deadline acquisition from Houston -- nearing his own return from a foot injury and scheduled to make a Triple-A rehab start Thursday. Anything involving Yesavage is cause for concern, though, and even if the Blue Jays’ postseason odds are very small, they haven’t reached zero yet, and this team remains intent on competing down the stretch.
The Blue Jays expect to have further updates on Yesavage either Wednesday in Houston or Thursday by the time they reach Chicago for a single makeup game.
items.titleZh: Yesavage 左膝不适退场，周三将接受 MRI
items.summaryZh: Yesavage 左膝不适离场，将接受核磁共振检查。
bodyZh: 休斯敦——Trey Yesavage 当地时间周二在休斯敦的比赛中因左膝不适离场，这对急需一些好运的蓝鸟队来说又是一次打击。
他计划于周三接受核磁共振检查，蓝鸟队届时将重新评估。
Yesavage 在第三局下半开始前投热身球时，主教练 John Schneider 和蓝鸟队的训练师突然从休息区跑了出来。
Schneider 在一旁看着 Yesavage 又投了一个热身球，但 Yesavage 很快摇了摇头，走下投手丘朝休息区走去。Yesavage 的左膝（他的落地腿）在早期投热身球时似乎打软了。Chad Dallas 顶替 Yesavage 上场，开始第三局下半局。
在以 7-2 输给太空人之后，Schneider 透露 Yesavage 的左膝感到一阵“刺痛”，虽然 Yesavage 本人似乎并不太担心，但他们不会拿这位年轻球星冒险。
“这很奇怪。这是一种刺痛感，他无法完全稳定下来，”Schneider 说，“之前没有任何预兆，这让我们有点措手不及。”
Yesavage 在前两局没有让对手击出安打，本赛季在 93 2/3 局中自责分率为 3.65，是这支近期经历重大变化的先发轮值中的年轻基石。就在 Yesavage 受伤的几个小时前，Schneider 透露了蓝鸟队的计划：在 Kevin Gausman 被交易后，随着 Jameson Taillon 从芝加哥小熊和 José Soriano 从洛杉矶天使加盟，他们将采用六人轮值。
深度目前并不是紧迫的问题，尤其是 Spencer Arrighetti——另一笔从休斯敦得到的交易截止日引援——即将从脚伤中复出，并计划于周四在 3A 联赛进行康复先发。不过，任何涉及 Yesavage 的事情都会引起担忧，而且即使蓝鸟队进入季后赛的几率非常小，但尚未归零，球队仍然决心在赛季末段竞争。
蓝鸟队预计将在周三于休斯敦或周四抵达芝加哥进行一场补赛时，带来关于 Yesavage 的进一步更新。

items.titleEn: Guerrero still optimistic about Blue Jays' season: 'Something good can happen'
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- The final two months of the Blue Jays’ season matter because they must matter. These cannot be empty days, filling time between now and the offseason.

Tuesday afternoon, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. stood in a changed clubhouse. He’s the face of the Blue Jays, a 53-60 team which had just traded Kevin Gausman, Jeff Hoffman and Daulton Varsho, all cornerstones of this team’s World Series run less than a year ago. They also made some major additions, led by José Soriano in the rotation, and it’s clear which direction this season is headed in. It’s been slowly skidding in that direction all year.
This isn’t complicated to Guerrero, either. Asked what needs to happen for this team to get back on track, he thinks for a moment and smiles, acknowledging just how obvious the answer is.

“I have to start hitting,” Guerrero said. “I have to start hitting. I think we’ve been playing good. Sometimes, we get shut down, but it’s always one game at a time. I need to get hot so that we can keep going and try to make the playoffs.”
The playoffs?

That’s still the goal, because it has to be. Teams like the Blue Jays don’t rebuild. Teams fresh off a World Series run with a $500 million player don’t rebuild, and teams packing 41,000 fans a night into Rogers Centre don’t rebuild. The Blue Jays want to make a run because that’s all there is left to do.

This is what makes trades like the Soriano addition so crucial, carrying momentum into a new year. Guerrero doesn’t want to talk about 2027, though. He doesn’t view that -- or anything else the Blue Jays did at the Deadline -- as a step back to focus on the future.

“I wouldn’t say next year,” Guerrero said. “We are four games back of the Wild Card. We are still competing. There are still 49 games. Something can happen. Go out there, have fun and play to win these games.”
Coming into play Tuesday, Guerrero was batting .261 with a .690 OPS. He has just six home runs, tied for 232nd in baseball, and hasn’t homered at Rogers Centre this season. Not once.

Given the true greatness we witnessed from Guerrero in the 2025 postseason, this has been one of the most stunning seasons in Blue Jays history. The offense as a whole has followed Guerrero, too, ranked last in scoring and tied for 28th in home runs with just 108 entering Tuesday. John Schneider has tried everything he can with the lineup, short of pulling names from a hat. He wants these players to let it rip and take some risks, anything to find a heartbeat again.

“It’s no secret we need some guys to go,” Schneider said. “There’s a fine line between waiting for that to happen and being really, really aggressive to make it happen. We’re going to need Springer, Vladimir, Kirk and Sánchez now that he’s back. We’re going to need them to drive the ball. It’s nice that you know your group a little bit. We’ve got to really lean into an identity.”
Guerrero, in the simplest terms, is the shortcut.

There’s not enough time left for this team to fix all of its flaws -- that’s for the offseason -- but if Vladdy were sitting here today with 20 home runs and a .900 OPS, we’d be having a much different conversation. The uncomfortable part of stardom is often realizing and acknowledging your own power, and Guerrero knows what a difference that he alone could make.

“My mindset is always positive. I’m going out there and trying to do the best I can to help the team win, every day,” Guerrero said. “If I’m not doing it with my bat, I’m doing it with my glove. I try to do something, all the time, to be better for my team. When you have that in your mind, something good can happen.”
There haven’t been enough good things happening in 2026. That’s why Gausman is in Chicago, Hoffman is in Minneapolis and Varsho walked across the field to Houston’s dugout on Monday.

The postseason isn’t realistic at this point, their odds at just 6.7% on FanGraphs, but these games still need to matter. Guerrero can make them matter, even if this all points toward a 2027 season he doesn’t want to acknowledge just yet.
items.titleZh: Guerrero仍对蓝鸟赛季乐观：‘好事可能发生’
items.summaryZh: Guerrero仍对蓝鸟赛季乐观，称自己需开始打击，球队仍有机会冲击季后赛。
bodyZh: 休斯敦——蓝鸟赛季最后两个月之所以重要，是因为它们必须重要。这些日子不能是现在与休赛期之间空白的时间。

周二下午，Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 站在一个已经改变的更衣室中。他是多伦多蓝鸟队的门面，这支球队战绩为53胜60负，刚刚交易走了 Kevin Gausman、Jeff Hoffman 和 Daulton Varsho，而这三人在不到一年前还是球队世界大赛征程的基石。他们也做了一些重大引援，最突出的是先发轮值中的 José Soriano，这个赛季的走向已经很清楚了。整个赛季都在朝着那个方向慢慢滑落。
这对 Guerrero 来说也不复杂。被问及这支球队需要发生什么才能重回正轨，他思考了一会儿，笑了笑，承认答案显而易见。
“我必须开始打击，”Guerrero 说。“我必须开始打击。我认为我们打得不错。有时候我们会熄火，但总是要一场一场来。我需要火热起来，这样我们才能继续前进，努力进入季后赛。”
季后赛？
这仍然是目标，因为必须是。像蓝鸟这样的球队不会重建。刚刚经历过世界大赛征程、拥有身价5亿美元球员的球队不会重建，每晚有41,000名球迷涌入罗杰斯中心的球队也不会重建。蓝鸟想要再拼一把，因为这是唯一剩下能做的事。
这就是像引进 Soriano 这样的交易如此关键的原因，为新年延续势头。不过，Guerrero 不想谈论2027年。他不认为那——或者蓝鸟在交易截止日所做的其他任何事情——是退一步去关注未来。
“我不会说是下一年，”Guerrero 说。“我们距离外卡只差4个胜场。我们仍在竞争。还有49场比赛。什么事都可能发生。上场去享受比赛，并赢得这些比赛。”
在周二比赛开始前，Guerrero 的打击率为 .261，OPS 为 .690。他仅有6支本垒打，在大联盟并列第232位，并且本赛季在罗杰斯中心没有击出过本垒打。一次也没有。
考虑到我们在2025年季后赛中见证的 Guerrero 的真正伟大，这已经成为蓝鸟历史上最令人震惊的赛季之一。整体进攻也跟随 Guerrero 下滑，得分排名垫底，本垒打数在周二比赛前以108支并列第28位。John Schneider 已经尝试了在阵容上能做的一切，就差从帽子里抽名字了。他希望这些球员放开手脚，冒险一试，任何能重新找到心跳的方法。
“我们需要一些人站出来，这不是秘密，”Schneider 说。“等待那一刻发生和非常非常积极地促使其发生之间有一条细微的界线。我们现在需要 Springer、Vladimir、Kirk 以及归队的 Sánchez。我们需要他们打出长打。了解自己的球员是件好事。我们必须真正坚持一种身份。”
简而言之，Guerrero 就是捷径。
这支球队已经没有足够的时间去修复所有缺陷——那是休赛期的事——但如果 Vladdy 今天坐在这里，拥有20支本垒打和 .900 的 OPS，我们的对话将会完全不同。成为明星的不舒服之处往往在于意识到并承认自己的力量，而 Guerrero 知道他一个人能带来多大的不同。
“我的心态总是积极的。我每天都上场，尽最大努力帮助球队获胜，”Guerrero 说。“如果不是用球棒，我就会用手套。我一直在努力做点什么，让球队变得更好。当你心中有这样的想法，好事就可能发生。”
2026年发生的好事还不够多。这就是为什么 Gausman 在芝加哥，Hoffman 在明尼阿波利斯，而 Varsho 周一穿过球场走进休斯敦的球员休息区。
季后赛在此时并不现实，FanGraphs 给出的概率仅为6.7%，但这些比赛仍然需要有意义。Guerrero 可以让它们有意义，即使这一切都指向一个他还不想承认的2027赛季。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays send former closer Hoffman to Twins for prospect package
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- The Blue Jays struck one last time before the bell rang at the Trade Deadline, dealing reliever Jeff Hoffman to the Twins for what looks like their highest-upside package of the Deadline.

That package was headlined by Minnesota’s No. 7 prospect, Dasan Hill (pronounced like “Jason”), a big, hard-throwing lefty with plenty of upside for the Blue Jays’ player development staff to play with. The 20-year-old is still very raw, but he touches 99 mph and has elite strikeout potential if he can wrangle all of that talent.
The Blue Jays weren’t just cashing in on a dominant two-month stretch from Hoffman, but also on the fact he has a year of club control remaining in 2027 for the Twins.

TRADE DETAILSToronto gets: LHP Dasan Hill (now Blue Jays' No. 6 prospect), RHP John Klein (now TOR No. 25), INF Dameury Pena and international signing bonus pool spaceMinnesota gets: RHP Jeff Hoffman and cash considerations

This one felt like it came together suddenly, within 30 minutes of the Deadline. One moment, Hoffman was strolling around the Blue Jays’ clubhouse with that same old swagger. The next moment, he was hugging his teammates, an emotional goodbye for a player who truly loved his time in Toronto.
“Once you play in a place like this, you don’t want to leave,” Hoffman said. “They definitely have a great thing going here. I think all organizations should strive to be like Toronto.”

Hoffman, 33, closed for Toronto last year, racking up 33 saves, and has 50 saves in his big league career. He’s tallied 75 strikeouts in 48 innings this year, giving the Twins relief corps a piece it simply didn’t have before. Yoendrys Gomez and Andrew Morris have been very effective finishing out games, but neither misses bats at that kind of rate.

Hoffman wasn’t the Blue Jays’ most obvious trade chip, given that he still has one year of control remaining in 2027 at $12,666,667, but the upside he represents turned Hoffman into a popular name leading up to the Trade Deadline. Currently in the second year of his three-year, $33 million deal signed with the Blue Jays, Hoffman will be a free agent following the 2027 season.

“This is not the situation we wanted to be in, where we’re parting ways with Jeff Hoffman,” said GM Ross Atkins. “We were given so much support that we didn’t have the pressure to do it if we weren’t able to get the return we felt made the most sense. It got across the line, where we felt it made too much sense for the organization. We would have certainly been pleased to have Jeff Hoffman tonight and next year, but that return and the shape of it made sense for us.”

In Toronto, Hoffman has been a lightning rod, constantly a source of debate among fans due to the extreme levels of variance between his good days and bad days. That boiled over in Game 7 of the World Series, when Hoffman was on the mound and just two outs away from sealing the Blue Jays’ first championship in over three decades when he gave up the game-tying home run to Dodgers No. 9 hitter Miguel Rojas. He’d been spectacular all postseason, but Hoffman’s tougher moments had a way of dominating the conversation.

“I will say this. I think it’s very unfair for Jeff Hoffman to be remembered by one pitch last year in Game 7,” manager John Schneider said. “That unfortunately comes with Game 7 when you’re pitching in the ninth inning, but what he’s done for us last year and this year, I’ll always be thankful for. The way he handled the early part of this season, too, that’s not an easy thing to do.”

That bled into 2026, with Hoffman losing the closer’s role to Louis Varland a month into the season. He’s gotten his home run problem from a year ago under control, though, and with a strikeout rate of 14.1 K/9, it’s obvious that the potential is still here for Hoffman to be a dominant back-end arm. If you catch him for the right stretch of 25-30 innings, there’s no reason Hoffman can’t be the best reliever added at this Deadline, his upper-90s fastball setting up a slider that hitters have struggled to even touch.
Hoffman now joins old teammate Tommy Nance, whom the Blue Jays dealt to the Twins in July, to make another run at the postseason in Minneapolis.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟将前终结者Hoffman交易至双城换取潜力新秀
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟将前终结者Hoffman交易至双城，换来潜力新秀组合。
bodyZh: 休斯顿——蓝鸟在交易截止日钟声敲响前最后一次出手，将后援投手Jeff Hoffman交易至双城，换来可能是他们截止日上限最高的新秀组合。
这笔交易的主角是明尼苏达第7号新秀Dasan Hill（发音类似“Jason”），他是一名身材高大、球速飞快的左手投手，蓝鸟球员培养团队在他身上有大量潜力可以挖掘。这位20岁小将仍然非常青涩，但他球速能达到99英里，如果他能驾驭所有这些天赋，他具备精英级的三振潜力。
蓝鸟不仅利用了Hoffman近两个月的统治级表现，还利用了他到2027年仍有一年球队控制权的事实。
交易详情 多伦多获得：左投手Dasan Hill（现蓝鸟第6号新秀）、右投手John Klein（现蓝鸟第25位）、内野手Dameury Pena以及国际签约奖金池空间 明尼苏达获得：右投手Jeff Hoffman和现金补偿
这笔交易感觉是在截止日前30分钟内突然达成的。前一分钟，Hoffman还带着那种惯有的自信在蓝鸟俱乐部踱步。后一分钟，他拥抱着队友，对一位真正热爱多伦多时光的球员来说，这是一次感人的告别。
“一旦你在这里打过球，你就不想离开，”Hoffman说。“他们这里绝对很出色。我认为所有球队都应该努力向多伦多看齐。”
现年33岁的Hoffman去年为多伦多担任终结者，累积33次救援成功，大联盟生涯共有50次救援。他今年在48局中三振75次，为双城牛棚增添了此前没有的拼图。Yoendrys Gomez和Andrew Morris在收尾比赛方面非常高效，但两人的三振率都达不到这种水平。
Hoffman并非蓝鸟最明显的交易筹码，因为他在2027年还有一年球队控制权，薪资为12,666,667美元，但他代表的潜力使Hoffman在交易截止日前成为热门名字。目前正处于与蓝鸟签下的三年3300万美元合同的第二年，Hoffman将在2027赛季结束后成为自由球员。
“这不是我们想要的情况，我们正与Jeff Hoffman分道扬镳，”总经理Ross Atkins表示。“我们得到了很多支持，如果我们无法获得我们认为最合理的回报，我们就不会有必须交易的压力。最终我们越过了那条线，觉得这对球队太有意义了。我们当然愿意今晚和明年都拥有Jeff Hoffman，但那份回报及其形式对我们很有意义。”
在多伦多，Hoffman一直是争议的焦点，由于他状态好与坏之间的巨大差异，常常成为球迷争论的对象。这一点在世界大赛第七场爆发，当时Hoffman站在投手丘上，距离为蓝鸟锁定三十多年来的首个冠军只差两个出局，却对道奇第9棒打者Miguel Rojas送出追平比分的本垒打。整个季后赛他都表现出色，但Hoffman艰难的瞬间总是主导着讨论。
“我要说，我认为让Jeff Hoffman因去年第七战的一球而被记住是非常不公平的，”主教练John Schneider表示。“不幸的是，第七战在第九局投球时就会遇到这种情况，但他去年和今年为我们所做的，我将永远感激。他处理本赛季早期困境的方式，也不是件容易的事。”
这种情况延续到了2026年，Hoffman在赛季开始一个月后将终结者角色输给了Louis Varland。不过，他已经控制住了去年以来的本垒打问题，并以14.1 K/9的三振率表明，Hoffman仍有潜力成为统治级的后段投手。如果你能在合适的25-30局中启用他，Hoffman完全有理由成为本次截止日引进的最佳后援投手，他90英里后半段的速球为打者难以碰到的滑球创造了机会。
Hoffman现在加入了老队友Tommy Nance的行列，后者在7月被蓝鸟交易至双城，两人将一起在明尼阿波利斯再次冲击季后赛。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays boast revamped prospect rankings after Deadline flurry
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- Everybody can exhale now. After six trades over a hectic 24 hours, the Blue Jays have finally made it through a complicated Trade Deadline.

If we had to pick one “label,” they were sellers, but they did that while also making one of the biggest splashes in baseball by adding right-hander José Soriano from the Angels for a package headlined by No. 2 prospect Arjun Nimmala. Elsewhere, they stockpiled prospects for the future.

“We’re fortunate that we were able to add some Major League pieces to a group that we feel like can compete,” GM Ross Atkins said. “Ultimately, we had to make the decision that we were determined to do what was best for the organization and try to optimize things, given a situation that was less than ideal. We feel good about our outcome.”
Here’s a look at the new guys in Toronto’s farm system:
Dasan Hill, LHP, High-A Vancouver Canadians

Acquired in: The Jeff Hoffman deal from the TwinsPipeline scouting report: No. 6 prospectOrganizational fit: Hill is all upside, a big left-hander who touches 99 mph. He’s struck out 160 batters in 107 career Minor League innings, but he’s also walked 77, so the Blue Jays will need to reel in that tremendous talent. There’s reliever risk here, but also a very high ceiling as a starter.ETA: 2028
Ty Southisene, INF, High-A Vancouver Canadians

Acquired in: The Kevin Gausman deal from the CubsPipeline scouting report: No. 17 prospectOrganizational fit: Southinese is a spark plug, an on-base machine who doesn’t hit for any power (zero homers in 157 games), but gets on base at a very high clip. He fits the model the Blue Jays like as a contact hitter, and is batting .306 with a .425 on-base percentage this season.ETA: 2028
Brett Bateman, CF, Triple-A Buffalo Bisons

Acquired in: Gausman dealPipeline scouting report: No. 20 prospectOrganizational fit: Another prospect who makes a ton of contact and gets on base -- but doesn’t hit for much power -- Bateman’s path to the big leagues will be driven by his strong defense in center field. Now that Daulton Varsho has also been traded to the Astros, Bateman could get his first shot at some point down the stretch in 2026.ETA: 2027
John Klein, RHP, Triple-A Buffalo Bisons

Acquired in: Hoffman dealPipeline scouting report: No. 25 prospectOrganizational fit: The 24-year-old made his MLB debut earlier this season and has posted a 5.91 ERA in Triple-A, working strictly as a starter. That’s where he’ll continue to develop for now, and he’ll have an opportunity to move into a depth starter’s role in 2027 and beyond, which would be valuable given how many injuries the Blue Jays have dealt with this season.ETA: 2026

items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟在截止日多笔交易后新秀排名提升。
bodyZh: 休斯敦——现在每个人都可以松一口气了。在忙碌的24小时内完成六笔交易后，蓝鸟队终于度过了复杂的交易截止日。
如果非要贴一个“标签”，他们是卖家，但他们同时也做出了棒球界最大的动作之一，从天使队换来右投手José Soriano，交易包裹以头号潜力新秀Arjun Nimmala为核心。此外，他们为未来囤积了潜力新秀。
“我们很幸运能够为这支我们认为有能力竞争的队伍增添一些大联盟拼图，”总经理Ross Atkins说道。“最终，我们必须做出决定，坚定地做对球队最有利的事情，并在不理想的情况下努力优化局面。我们对结果感到满意。”
以下是蓝鸟小联盟系统中的新面孔：
Dasan Hill，左投手，高级A级温哥华加拿大人队
交易获得：来自双城队的Jeff Hoffman交易 球探报告排名：第6号潜力新秀 球队适配度：Hill充满潜力，是一名高大的左投手，球速可达99英里。他在小联盟107局中三振160名打者，但也保送了77人，因此蓝鸟队需要收拢这位天赋异禀的球员。这里有成为后援投手的风险，但作为先发投手也有很高的上限。预计登上大联盟时间：2028年
