items.titleEn: Blue Jays acquire RHP Arrighetti, send Varsho to Astros while in Houston
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- The Blue Jays have agreed to a trade to send Daulton Varsho across the diamond here in Houston to join the Astros, the team confirmed Monday.

The deal will net the Blue Jays 26-year-old righty starter Spencer Arrighetti, another long-term addition for their rotation after landing José Soriano from the Angels in a big, splashy deal Monday morning.

Shortly after 2 p.m. CT in Houston, Varsho strolled out to center field at Daikin Park, wandering around the wall and warning track to get a feel for its dimensions. Just over one hour later, news broke of the deal. By the time Varsho packs his bags and moves clubhouses, he could be active for the Astros as soon as tonight for the series opener.
TRADE DETAILS:Toronto receives: RHP Spencer ArrighettiHouston receives: OF Daulton Varsho

This is the Blue Jays’ third move of the day and their fifth ahead of the Deadline. After the Soriano deal earlier Monday, this represents more of a classic “seller” move, which could continue leading up to the Deadline, with George Springer, Shane Bieber, Max Scherzer, Luis Urías and Jeff Hoffman all potential options to be moved at the right price.

Varsho came into this season primed for a big contract year and looked great in Spring Training, but that hasn’t carried over into the season. He’d originally looked like he had the potential to emerge as one of the top position players on the free-agent market with a big offensive year alongside his Gold Glove-caliber defense, but he’s hit just .243 with a .682 OPS and his defense has surprisingly taken a step back.

Still, Varsho has been a key piece in this era of Blue Jays baseball, and his departure is yet another sign that we’re entering a new one. Varsho represented one of the biggest swings we’ve ever seen from this front office when they acquired him from the D-backs for catching prospect Gabriel Moreno, who has grown into a star in Arizona, and Lourdes Gurriel Jr.

Arrighetti is a solid return for two months of Varsho, the Blue Jays opting to target controllable starting pitching over another prospect they may need to wait on. While the Soriano addition raised the ceiling of this 2027 and ‘28 rotation significantly, Arrighetti could raise the floor. He’s currently on the IL with right foot nerve irritation, but has been throwing bullpen sessions and expects to pitch again in ‘26.
Blue Jays' 2027 rotation projection1. Dylan Cease2. José Soriano3. Trey Yesavage4. Cody Ponce5. TBD

That "TBD" is getting more interesting now, and will be opened up to a group that includes Arrighetti. Rule 5 Draft wonder Spencer Miles is another candidate as the Blue Jays likely stretch him out next season, and they are expected to continue to address the decision. Even after they entered 2026 with what seemed like incredible rotation depth, they’ve been spread thin throughout the season.

Arrighetti doesn’t light up the radar gun, living near 93 mph, but his big curveball is the star of his arsenal. He’ll be the latest project for Pete Walker and the Blue Jays’ pitching coaches, who will need to drag down his walk rate (5.1 BB/9) from the past two seasons to develop Arrighetti into a full-time option.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟送出 Varsho，从太空人换来 Arrighetti
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟将 Daulton Varsho 交易至太空人，换来右投手 Spencer Arrighetti。
bodyZh: 休斯敦讯——蓝鸟队周一确认，球队已达成交易，将 Daulton Varsho 交易至休斯敦太空人队。
这笔交易将为蓝鸟队带来 26 岁的右投手先发 Spencer Arrighetti，这是继周一早上从天使队换来 José Soriano 的大手笔之后，球队轮换阵容的又一长期补充。
休斯敦时间下午 2 点刚过，Varsho 漫步走到 Daikin Park 的中外野，沿着外野墙和警告区走动，感受球场的大小。一个多小时后，这笔交易的消息传出。等到 Varsho 收拾行装、更换球队时，他最早可能于今晚系列赛揭幕战就为太空人队出战。
交易详情：多伦多得到：右投手 Spencer Arrighetti；休斯敦得到：外野手 Daulton Varsho。
这是蓝鸟队当天的第三笔操作，也是交易截止日前的第五笔。在周一早些时候完成 Soriano 交易后，这笔交易更像是典型的“卖家”操作，这种操作可能会持续到截止日前，George Springer、Shane Bieber、Max Scherzer、Luis Urías 和 Jeff Hoffman 都可能以合适的价格被送走。
Varsho 本赛季开始时正处于合同年，有望获得大合同，他在春训中表现也很出色，但这一状态没能延续到常规赛。他原本看起来有潜力成为自由球员市场上顶级位置球员之一，如果他能打出出色的进攻赛季并保持金手套级别的防守，但他本赛季打击率仅为 .243，OPS 为 .682，而且防守也出人意料地有所退步。
尽管如此，Varsho 一直是蓝鸟队这个时代的关键成员，他的离开再次表明球队正在进入新时代。当初蓝鸟队管理层用捕手新秀 Gabriel Moreno（如今已在亚利桑那成长为球星）和 Lourdes Gurriel Jr. 从响尾蛇队换来 Varsho，这是该管理层迄今最大的一次冒险。
对于两个月的 Varsho 来说，Arrighetti 是一份不错的回报，蓝鸟队选择瞄准可控的先发投手，而不是再等待一位新秀。Soriano 的加盟提高了球队 2027 和 2028 赛季轮换的上限，而 Arrighetti 则可能提高下限。他目前因右脚神经刺激被列入伤病名单，但一直在进行牛棚投球，预计将在 2026 年再次出赛。
蓝鸟队 2027 年轮值预测：1. Dylan Cease；2. José Soriano；3. Trey Yesavage；4. Cody Ponce；5. 待定
现在这个“待定”变得更有意思了，候选名单中包括 Arrighetti。规则 5 选秀的惊喜球员 Spencer Miles 是另一个候选人，蓝鸟队下赛季可能将他拉长为先发，他们预计将继续处理这一决定。尽管球队在进入 2026 赛季时轮值深度看似惊人，但整个赛季中他们已经捉襟见肘。
Arrighetti 的球速并不惊人，大约在 93 英里/小时左右，但他那枚大曲线球是其武器库中最出色的。他将是 Pete Walker 和蓝鸟队投手教练们的最新课题，他们需要降低他过去两个赛季高达 5.1 次/9 局的保送率，才能将 Arrighetti 培养成一位全职先发。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays trade for RHP Soriano, deal No. 2 prospect Nimmala to Halos
bodyEn: A day after ending an era by trading Kevin Gausman to the Cubs, the Blue Jays acquired a starter to replace him, acquiring right-hander José Soriano from the Angels for three prospects. The deal sends SS Arjun Nimmala (Toronto's No. 2 prospect), OF Eddie Micheletti and RHP Angel Rivero to the Halos.

Nobody had a more impressive start to the season than Soriano, who posted a 0.84 ERA through his first seven starts through the end of April. He came back down to earth with a 5.14 ERA over his next 13 outings to finish the first half with a 3.49 ERA in 20 starts.

Soriano started the second half by throwing seven strong innings against the Cardinals, looking much more like he did early in the year. The right-hander followed with five innings of one-run ball (zero earned runs) against the Giants on July 26, and the Angels scratched him from what would have been his final pre-Deadline start against the Brewers on Saturday, citing trade uncertainty.

The key for Soriano is simply throwing strikes, as he’s had issues with walks this season but has tantalizing good stuff. He’s also just 27 years old and remains under team control through 2028, so he’s not a rental player.
TRADE DETAILSBlue Jays receive: RHP José SorianoAngels receive: SS Arjun Nimmala (TOR's No. 2 prospect), OF Eddie Micheletti, RHP Angel Rivero

There are few pitchers in baseball with an arsenal that can match Soriano’s, as he possesses a 96.5 mph power sinker to go along with his 92 mph splitter and 85 mph knuckle curveball. He's also been throwing his 98 mph four-seamer much more than in the past, which has helped him generate more strikeouts at the top of the zone. Soriano is also just one of a handful of starting pitchers with a ground-ball rate above 50 percent and was an incredible 65.3 percent last year.

This is Soriano’s third year as a starting pitcher after he served as an effective reliever with a 3.64 ERA in 42 innings as a rookie in '23. He's built up his workload since then, including a season-high 169 innings last year, and is set to eclipse that total this year.

Soriano underwent Tommy John surgery as a Minor Leaguer in February 2020 and was lost to the Pirates with the No. 1 overall pick in the Rule 5 Draft. But he was returned to the Angels in November 2021 after he had another operation on his right elbow. Soriano made a full recovery, and it turned out to be a blessing for the Angels.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟交易得到右投 José Soriano，将2号新秀 Arjun Nimmala 送至天使
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟用2号新秀 Nimmala 等三名球员从天使换来右投 Soriano。
bodyZh: 在将 Kevin Gausman 交易到小熊、结束一个时代的一天后，蓝鸟得到一名先发投手来替代他，从天使换来右投 José Soriano，送出三名新秀。这笔交易将游击手 Arjun Nimmala（蓝鸟2号新秀）、外野手 Eddie Micheletti 和右投 Angel Rivero 送往天使。
本赛季开局阶段，没有人比 Soriano 更令人印象深刻，他在四月底前的前七场先发中自责分率仅为 0.84。但在接下来的13次出赛中，他的自责分率高达5.14，上半场结束时他在20场先发中自责分率为3.49。
Soriano 下半季首战面对红雀投了7局强势表现，看起来更像赛季初的自己。这位右投手随后在7月26日对阵巨人时投了5局仅失1分（自责分0分）。由于交易存在不确定性，天使队在周六将他从原定交易截止日前最后一次先发（对阵酿酒人）中撤下。
对 Soriano 来说，关键是投出好球，他本赛季保送存在问题，但球威诱人。他今年才27岁，合同持续到2028年，因此并非租借球员。
交易详情：蓝鸟得到：右投 José Soriano；天使得到：游击手 Arjun Nimmala（多伦多2号新秀）、外野手 Eddie Micheletti、右投 Angel Rivero。
棒球界很少有投手的投球组合能与 Soriano 匹敌，他拥有96.5英里的强力下沉球，以及92英里的指叉球和85英里的指节曲球。他比过去更多地使用98英里的四缝线快速球，这帮助他在好球带顶部制造更多三振。Soriano 也是少数滚地球率超过50%的先发投手之一，去年更是高达惊人的65.3%。
这是 Soriano 作为先发投手的第三个赛季，此前他在23年作为新秀是一名高效后援投手，42局自责分率3.64。此后他逐步增加工作量，包括上赛季创下赛季新高的169局，本赛季有望超越这一数字。
Soriano 在2020年2月作为小联盟球员接受了 Tommy John 手术，并在规则5选秀中被海盗以第1顺位选中。但在2021年11月因右肘再次手术而被退回天使。Soriano 完全康复，这对天使来说最终是一份幸事。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays keep adding, land versatile Smith from Rangers
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- With the rest of the trade market waiting for the Blue Jays to sell, they’ve turned around and made another addition.

Hours after adding José Soriano from the Angels for a package headlined by No. 2 prospect Arjun Nimmala, Toronto announced it has agreed to terms on another trade, with the Rangers for infielder Josh Smith.

In the deal, first reported by Evan Grant, the Blue Jays will acquire Smith and Triple-A righty Josh Stephan in exchange for left-hander Adam Macko, who’s seen multiple stints with the big club this season.
TRADE DETAILS:
Toronto gets: INF Josh Smith, RHP Josh StephanTexas gets: LHP Adam Macko

This deal captures a Blue Jays front office that is open to anything at the Trade Deadline. They’ve already “sold” Kevin Gausman and “bought” Soriano, but this deal falls somewhere in the middle, supplementing the Blue Jays’ position player depth while adding a depth starter in Triple-A, which could be valuable down the stretch.

This has been a difficult season for Smith, who’s batting just .213 with a .571 OPS over 45 big league games, but his 2024-25 seasons paint a different picture. Across those two seasons, Smith put up a .716 OPS while playing all over the diamond at second, third and the corner-outfield spots. This gives Smith pathways to potential playing time down the stretch in Toronto, depending on what other moves are made, and he could be a useful depth piece going forward.

Smith is under club control for two more seasons and still has option years remaining, which could be very valuable if he sticks with the organization through arbitration. The stretch run in Toronto could determine just how likely that is.

Stephan is an important part of the package, too, a 24-year-old who has posted a 5.44 ERA over 101 innings this season in Triple-A. He’s lost some of his prospect shine this season and was unranked on the Rangers’ Top 30 list, but the Blue Jays have been thin on true “starters” in Triple-A this season and would like to have a more stable group moving forward. If Stephan can settle in and develop into an optionable pitcher capable of making the odd spot start, that would be a great development.

Macko was one of the best development stories in the Blue Jays’ system. The Slovakian-born lefty made a quick stop in Ireland before coming to Canada, where he played high school ball in Alberta. Macko recently represented Team Canada at the World Baseball Classic, too, and owned a 4.91 ERA over 22 innings in the big leagues this season.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟继续补强，从游骑兵换来多面手史密斯
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟从游骑兵交易得到内野手史密斯。
bodyZh: 休斯敦——在交易市场的其他球队都在等待蓝鸟出售球员时，蓝鸟却转身进行了又一次补强。
在将潜力新秀阿琼·尼马拉（二号新秀）等筹码送到天使，换来何塞·索里亚诺几小时后，多伦多宣布与游骑兵达成另一笔交易，换来内野手乔什·史密斯。
据埃文·格兰特率先报道，在这笔交易中，蓝鸟将得到史密斯和3A右投手乔什·斯蒂芬，送出本赛季多次随大联盟球队征战的左投手亚当·麦科。
交易详情：
多伦多得到：内野手乔什·史密斯、右投手乔什·斯蒂芬；得克萨斯得到：左投手亚当·麦科。
这笔交易展现了蓝鸟管理层在交易截止日对所有可能性持开放态度。他们已“卖出”凯文·高斯曼并“买入”索里亚诺，但这笔交易介于两者之间，既补充了蓝鸟的野手深度，又增加了一名3A深度先发，这在冲刺阶段可能很有价值。
对史密斯来说，这是一个艰难的赛季，他在大联盟45场比赛中打击率仅为.213，OPS为.571，但他2024-25赛季的表现则让人看到另一面。这两个赛季，史密斯的OPS达到.716，并且守过二垒、三垒和外野角落，堪称全能。这为史密斯在多伦多冲刺阶段争取出场时间提供了可能，具体取决于球队其他操作，他也可能成为未来有用的深度人选。
史密斯还有两个赛季的球队控制权，且仍有可用的选项年，如果他进入仲裁阶段并留队，这将非常有价值。他在多伦多的冲刺阶段表现可能决定这种可能性有多大。
斯蒂芬也是这笔交易的重要组成部分，这位24岁的右投手本赛季在3A投了101局，自责分率为5.44。他本赛季失去了一些新秀光环，未进入游骑兵前30新秀榜，但蓝鸟本赛季在3A缺少真正的“先发投手”，他们希望未来有更稳定的轮换储备。如果斯蒂芬能稳定下来，发展成一名可下放、能偶尔顶替先发的投手，那将是一个很好的结果。
麦科是蓝鸟体系中最好的发展故事之一。这位出生于斯洛伐克的左投手在来加拿大之前曾短暂停留爱尔兰，在阿尔伯塔打了高中棒球。麦科最近还代表加拿大参加了世界棒球经典赛，本赛季在大联盟22局中自责分率为4.91。
